text: Joseph of Arimathea, an honorable counsellor, who also waited for the kingdom of God, came and went in boldly to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

title: Mark 15:44
text: And Pilate wondered if He were already dead. And calling the centurion, he asked him whether He had died already.

title: Mark 15:45
text: And when he knew [it] from the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

title: Mark 15:46
text: And he bought a linen cloth, and took Him down, and wrapped [Him] in the linen, and laid Him in a tomb which was cut out of a rock, and rolled a stone to the door of the tomb.

title: Mark 15:47
text: And Mary Magdalene and Mary [the mother] of Joses saw where He was laid.

title: Mark 16:1
text: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene and Mary, [the mother] of James and Salome, had bought sweet spices so that they might come and anoint Him.

title: Mark 16:2
text: And very early in the morning, the first [day] of the week, they came upon the tomb, the sun having risen.

title: Mark 16:3
text: And they said among themselves, Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?

title: Mark 16:4
text: And looking up, they saw that the stone had been rolled back, for it was very great.

title: Mark 16:5
text: And entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right, clothed [in] a long white garment. And they were frightened.

title: Mark 16:6
text: And he said to them, Do not be frightened. You seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He is risen, He is not here. Behold the place where they laid Him.

title: Mark 16:7
text: But go tell His disciples and Peter that He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see Him, as He said to you.

title: Mark 16:8
text: And they went out quickly and fled from the tomb. For they trembled and were amazed. Neither did they say anything to anyone, for they were afraid.

title: Mark 16:9
text: And when [Jesus] had risen early the first [day] of the week, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom He had cast seven demons.

title: Mark 16:10
text: She went [and] told those who had been with Him, as they mourned and wept.

title: Mark 16:11
text: And those hearing that He lives, and was seen by her, they did not believe.

title: Mark 16:12
text: After that He appeared in another form to two of them, walking [and] going into the country.

title: Mark 16:13
text: And they went and told [it] to the rest. Neither did they believe those.

title: Mark 16:14
text: Afterward He appeared to the Eleven as they reclined. And [He] reproached their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they did not believe those who had seen Him after He had risen.

title: Mark 16:15
text: And He said to them, Go into all the world, proclaim the gospel to all the creation.

title: Mark 16:16
text: He who believes and is baptized will be saved, but he who does not believe will be condemned.

title: Mark 16:17
text: And signs will follow to those believing these things: in My name they will cast out demons; they will speak new tongues;

title: Mark 16:18
text: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will not hurt them. They will lay hands on [the] sick, and they will be well.

title: Mark 16:19
text: Then indeed, after speaking to them, the Lord was taken up into Heaven, and sat on [the] right hand of God.

title: Mark 16:20
text: And going out, they proclaimed everywhere, the Lord working with [them] and confirming the word by signs following.

title: Luke 1:1
text: Since many took in hand to draw up an account concerning the matters which have been borne out among us,

title: Luke 1:2
text: even as those who from [the] beginning delivered to us, becoming eye-witnesses and ministers of the word,

title: Luke 1:3
text: it seemed good to me also, following all things accurately from the very first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus,

title: Luke 1:4
text: so that you might know the certainty of those things in which you have been instructed.

title: Luke 1:5
text: In the days of Herod, the king of Judea, there was a certain priest named Zacharias, of [the] course of Abijah. And his wife [was] of the daughters of Aaron, and her name [was] Elizabeth.

title: Luke 1:6
text: And they were both righteous before God, walking blameless in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

title: Luke 1:7
text: And they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren. And both were advanced in their days.

title: Luke 1:8
text: And it happened in his serving in the order of his course, before God,

title: Luke 1:9
text: according to the custom of the priests, it was his lot to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

title: Luke 1:10
text: And all the multitude of the people were praying outside at the time of incense.

title: Luke 1:11
text: And an angel [of the] Lord appeared to him as he was standing on [the] right of the altar of incense.

title: Luke 1:12
text: And seeing [this], Zacharias was troubled, and fear fell on him.

title: Luke 1:13
text: But the angel said to him, Do not fear, Zacharias. For your prayer is heard, and your wife Elizabeth shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

title: Luke 1:14
text: And you shall have joy and gladness, and many shall rejoice at his birth.

title: Luke 1:15
text: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall neither drink wine nor strong drink. And he shall be filled with [the] Holy Spirit, even from his mother's womb.

title: Luke 1:16
text: And he shall turn many of the sons of Israel to [the] Lord their God.

title: Luke 1:17
text: And he shall go before Him in [the] spirit and power of Elijah, to turn [the] hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to [the] wisdom of the just, to make ready a people prepared for [the] Lord.

title: Luke 1:18
text: And Zacharias said to the angel, By what shall I know this? For I am old, and my wife is advanced in her days.

title: Luke 1:19
text: And answering, the angel said to him, I am Gabriel, who stands before God. And I am sent to speak to you and to show you these glad tidings.

title: Luke 1:20
text: And behold, you shall be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things shall be performed, because you did not believe my words which shall be fulfilled in their time.

title: Luke 1:21
text: And the people waited for Zacharias and marveled that he stayed so long in the temple.

title: Luke 1:22
text: And when he came out, he could not speak to them. And they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. And he was making signs to them, and remained speechless.

title: Luke 1:23
text: And as soon as the days of his service were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

title: Luke 1:24
text: And after those days his wife Elizabeth conceived and hid herself five months, saying,

title: Luke 1:25
text: So the Lord has dealt with me in the days in which He looked on [me], to take away my reproach among men.

title: Luke 1:26
text: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God into a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

title: Luke 1:27
text: to a virgin betrothed to a man whose name was Joseph, of [the] house of David. And the virgin's name [was] Mary.

title: Luke 1:28
text: And the angel came in to her and said, Hail, [one] receiving grace, the Lord [is] with you. Blessed [are] you among women.

title: Luke 1:29
text: And when she saw [him], she was troubled at his saying, and considered what kind of greeting this might be.

title: Luke 1:30
text: And the angel said to her, Do not fear, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

title: Luke 1:31
text: And behold! You shall conceive in [your] womb and bear a son, and you shall call His name JESUS.

title: Luke 1:32
text: He shall be great and shall be called the Son of [the] Highest. And the Lord God shall give Him the throne of His father David.

title: Luke 1:33
text: And He shall reign over the house of David forever, and of His kingdom there shall be no end.

title: Luke 1:34
text: Then Mary said to the angel, How shall this be, since I do not know a man?

title: Luke 1:35
text: And the angel answered and said to her, The Holy Spirit shall come on you, and [the] power of [the] Highest shall overshadow you. Therefore also that Holy [One] which will be born of you shall be called Son of God.

title: Luke 1:36
text: And behold, your cousin Elizabeth also conceived a son in her old age. And this [is] the sixth month with her who [was] called barren.

title: Luke 1:37
text: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

title: Luke 1:38
text: And Mary said, Behold the servant of [the] Lord. Let it be to me according to your word. And the angel departed from her.

title: Luke 1:39
text: And Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, to a city of Judah.

title: Luke 1:40
text: And [she] entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

title: Luke 1:41
text: And it happened as Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb. And Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit,

title: Luke 1:42
text: and cried out with a loud voice and said, Blessed [are] you among women, and blessed [is] the fruit of your womb.

title: Luke 1:43
text: And from where [is] this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

title: Luke 1:44
text: For lo, as the voice of your greeting sounded in my ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

title: Luke 1:45
text: And blessed [is] she who believes, for there shall be a perfecting of those things which were told her from [the] Lord.

title: Luke 1:46
text: And Mary said, My soul magnifies the Lord,

title: Luke 1:47
text: and my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior.

title: Luke 1:48
text: For He looked on the humiliation of His slave woman. For, behold, from now on all generations shall count me blessed.

title: Luke 1:49
text: For the Mighty One has done great things for me; and holy [is] His name.

title: Luke 1:50
text: And His mercy [is] on those who fear Him from generation to generation.

title: Luke 1:51
text: He has worked power with His arm, He has scattered the proud in [the] imagination of their heart.

title: Luke 1:52
text: He has put down rulers from [their] seats and exalted the lowly,

title: Luke 1:53
text: He has filled [the] hungry with good things, and He has sent away [the] rich empty.

title: Luke 1:54
text: He has helped His servant Israel, in remembrance of [His] mercy,

title: Luke 1:55
text: as He spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his seed forever.

title: Luke 1:56
text: And Mary stayed with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

title: Luke 1:57
text: And the time was fulfilled to Elizabeth [for] her to bear. And she bore a son.

title: Luke 1:58
text: And her neighbors and her kinsfolk heard how [the] Lord had magnified His mercy with her, and they rejoiced with her.

title: Luke 1:59
text: And it happened that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and were calling it Zacharias, after his father's name.

title: Luke 1:60
text: And his mother answered and said, No, but he shall be called John.

title: Luke 1:61
text: And they said to her, There is none of your kindred that is called by this name.

title: Luke 1:62
text: And they made signs to his father as to how he would have him called.

title: Luke 1:63
text: And he asked for a writing tablet and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they all marveled.

title: Luke 1:64
text: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue [loosened]. And he spoke and praised God.

title: Luke 1:65
text: And fear came on all who lived all around them. And all these things were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

title: Luke 1:66
text: And all those who heard laid [them] up in their hearts, saying, What kind of child shall this be! And the hand of [the] Lord was with him.

title: Luke 1:67
text: And his father Zacharias was filled with [the] Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

title: Luke 1:68
text: Blessed [is the] Lord, the God of Israel, for He has visited and redeemed His people

title: Luke 1:69
text: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,

title: Luke 1:70
text: as He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets from eternity;

title: Luke 1:71
text: that we should be saved from our enemies and from [the] hand of all who hate us,

title: Luke 1:72
text: to perform the mercy [promised] to our fathers, and to remember His holy covenant,

title: Luke 1:73
text: [the] oath which He swore to our father Abraham,

title: Luke 1:74
text: that He would grant to us, [that we], being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, might serve Him without fear

title: Luke 1:75
text: in holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our life.

title: Luke 1:76
text: And you, child, will be called the prophet of [the] Highest, for you shall go before [the] face of [the] Lord to prepare His ways,

title: Luke 1:77
text: to give knowledge of salvation to His people by the remission of their sins,

title: Luke 1:78
text: through [the] tender mercy of our God; by which [the] Dayspring from on high has visited us,

title: Luke 1:79
text: to give light to those who sit in darkness and [in] the shadow of death, to guide our feet into [the] way of peace.

title: Luke 1:80
text: And the child grew and became strong in spirit and was in the deserts until [the] day of his showing to Israel.

title: Luke 2:1
text: And it happened in those days that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed.

title: Luke 2:2
text: (This taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

title: Luke 2:3
text: And all went to be registered, each to [his] own city.

title: Luke 2:4
text: And Joseph also went up from Galilee to be taxed (out of [the] city of Nazareth, into Judea, to [the] city of David which is called Bethlehem, because he was of [the] house and family line of David).

title: Luke 2:5
text: And he took Mary his betrothed wife, being with child.

title: Luke 2:6
text: And while they were there, the days [for] her deliverance were fulfilled.

title: Luke 2:7
text: And she brought forth her son, the First-born, and wrapped Him, and laid Him in a manger-- because there was no room for them in the inn.

title: Luke 2:8
text: And in the same country there were shepherds living in the field, keeping watch over their flock [by] night.

title: Luke 2:9
text: And lo, the angel of [the] Lord came on them, and [the] glory of [the] Lord shone around them. And they were grievously afraid.

title: Luke 2:10
text: And the angel said to them, Do not fear. For behold, I give to you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

title: Luke 2:11
text: For to you is born today, in [the] city of David, a Savior, who is Christ [the] Lord.

title: Luke 2:12
text: And this [is] a sign to you. You will find the babe wrapped, lying in a manger.

title: Luke 2:13
text: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of [the] heavenly host, praising God and saying,

title: Luke 2:14
text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

title: Luke 2:15
text: And it happened as the angels departed from them into Heaven, the shepherds said to one another, Indeed, let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing which has happened, which the Lord made known to us.

title: Luke 2:16
text: And hurrying they came and sought out both Mary and Joseph, and the babe lying in the manger.

title: Luke 2:17
text: And seeing, they publicly told about the word spoken to them concerning this Child.

title: Luke 2:18
text: And all those who heard marveled about the things spoken to them by the shepherds.

title: Luke 2:19
text: But Mary kept all these sayings, meditating in her heart.

title: Luke 2:20
text: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as was spoken to them.

title: Luke 2:21
text: And when eight days were fulfilled to circumcise the child, His name was called JESUS, [the name] called by the angel before He was conceived in the womb.

title: Luke 2:22
text: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought Him to Jerusalem, to present [Him] to the Lord

title: Luke 2:23
text: (as it is written in [the] Law of the Lord, Every male that opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord)

title: Luke 2:24
text: and to offer a sacrifice according to that said in the Law of [the] Lord, A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.

title: Luke 2:25
text: And behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name [was] Simeon. And this man [was] just and devout, waiting for [the] Consolation of Israel. And [the] Holy Spirit was on him.

title: Luke 2:26
text: And it happened to him, being instructed by the Holy Spirit, he was not to see death before he would see [the] Christ of [the] Lord.

title: Luke 2:27
text: And he came by the Spirit into the temple. And [as] the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do according to the custom of the law concerning Him,

title: Luke 2:28
text: even he received Him in his arms and blessed God, and said,

title: Luke 2:29
text: Lord, now You will let Your servant depart in peace, according to Your word.

title: Luke 2:30
text: For my eyes have seen Your Salvation

title: Luke 2:31
text: which You have prepared before [the] face of all the peoples,

title: Luke 2:32
text: a light for revelation [to the] nations, and the glory of Your people Israel.

title: Luke 2:33
text: And Joseph and His mother marveled at those things which were spoken by him.

title: Luke 2:34
text: And Simeon blessed them and said to Mary His mother, Behold, this One is set for [the] fall and rising again of many in Israel, and for a sign spoken against

title: Luke 2:35
text: (yea, a sword shall pierce through your own soul also), so that [the] thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

title: Luke 2:36
text: And there was a prophetess, Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of [the] tribe of Asher. She was advanced in many days, and had lived with a husband seven years from her virginity.

title: Luke 2:37
text: And she [was] a widow [of] eighty-four years, who did not depart from the temple, serving God with fastings and prayers night and day.

title: Luke 2:38
text: And she coming in at that instant gave thanks to the Lord and spoke of Him to all those in Jerusalem eagerly expecting redemption.

title: Luke 2:39
text: And when they had finished all things according to [the] Law of [the] Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

title: Luke 2:40
text: And the Child grew and became strong in spirit, filled with wisdom. And the grace of God was on Him.

title: Luke 2:41
text: And His parents went to Jerusalem every year at the Feast of the Passover.

title: Luke 2:42
text: And when He was twelve years [old], they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the Feast.

title: Luke 2:43
text: And fulfilling the days, as they returned, the boy Jesus stayed in Jerusalem. And Joseph and His mother did not know.

title: Luke 2:44
text: But they, supposing Him to have been in the company, went a day's journey. And they looked for Him among the kinsfolk and acquaintances.

title: Luke 2:45
text: And when they did not find Him, they turned back to Jerusalem, seeking Him.

title: Luke 2:46
text: And it happened that after three days they found Him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both hearing them and questioning them.

title: Luke 2:47
text: And all who heard Him were astonished at His understanding and answers.

title: Luke 2:48
text: And seeing Him, they were amazed. And His mother said to Him, Child, why have you done so to us? Behold, your father and I have looked for you, greatly distressed.

title: Luke 2:49
text: And He said to them, Why did you look for Me? Do you not know that I must be about My Father's [business]?

title: Luke 2:50
text: And they did not understand the word which He spoke to them.

title: Luke 2:51
text: And He went with them and came to Nazareth, and He was subject to them. But His mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

title: Luke 2:52
text: And Jesus increased [in] wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.

title: Luke 3:1
text: And in [the] fifteenth year of the government of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and [the] Trachonitus country, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene--

title: Luke 3:2
text: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests-- the word of God came to John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

title: Luke 3:3
text: And he came into all the country around Jordan, proclaiming the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins,

title: Luke 3:4
text: as it is written in [the] book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, saying, "[The] voice of one crying in the wilderness, prepare the way of [the] Lord, make His paths straight.

title: Luke 3:5
text: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low, and the crooked shall be straight, and the rough ways [shall be] made smooth.

title: Luke 3:6
text: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God."

title: Luke 3:7
text: Then he said to the crowd that came forth to be baptized by him, O generation of vipers! Who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

title: Luke 3:8
text: Therefore bring forth fruits worthy of repentance, and do not begin to say within yourselves, We have Abraham for [our] father. For I say to you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

title: Luke 3:9
text: And now also the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Therefore every tree which does not bring forth good fruit is cut down and cast into the fire.

title: Luke 3:10
text: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

title: Luke 3:11
text: He answered and said to them, He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. And he who has food, let him do likewise.

title: Luke 3:12
text: And tax-collectors also came to be baptized and said to him, Teacher, what shall we do?

title: Luke 3:13
text: And he said to them, Continue to do no more than that commanded to you.

title: Luke 3:14
text: And the soldiers also asked of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said to them, Do not oppress anyone, nor accuse [any] falsely. And be content with your wages.

title: Luke 3:15
text: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts concerning John, lest perhaps he was the Christ,

title: Luke 3:16
text: John answered all, saying, I indeed baptize you with water, but He who is mightier than I comes, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to loose. He shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire,

title: Luke 3:17
text: whose fan [is] in His hand, and He will thoroughly purge His floor and will gather the wheat into His storehouse. But He will burn the chaff with unquenchable fire.

title: Luke 3:18
text: And then indeed exhorting many things, he proclaimed the gospel to the people.

title: Luke 3:19
text: But Herod the tetrarch (being reproved by him on account of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, and for all [the] evils which Herod had done)

title: Luke 3:20
text: added still this above all, that he even shut John up in prison.

title: Luke 3:21
text: And it happened in the baptizing of all the people, Jesus also being baptized, and praying, and the heaven was opened.

title: Luke 3:22
text: And the Holy Spirit came down in a bodily shape, like a dove on Him. And a voice came from Heaven, which said, You are My Son, the Beloved; I am delighted in You.

title: Luke 3:23
text: And Jesus Himself was beginning to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) son of Joseph, [son of] of Heli,

title: Luke 3:24
text: [son of] of Matthat, [son of] of Levi, [son of] of Melchi, [son of] of Janna, [son of] of Joseph,

title: Luke 3:25
text: [son of] of Mattathias, [son of] of Amos, [son of] of Nahum, [son of] of Esli, [son of] of Naggai,

title: Luke 3:26
text: [son of] of Maath, [son of] of Mattathias, [son of] of Semei, [son of] of Joseph, [son of] of Juda,

title: Luke 3:27
text: [son of] of Joanna, [son of] of Rhesa, [son of] of Zerubbabel, [son of] of Shealtiel, [son of] of Neri,

title: Luke 3:28
text: [son of] of Melchi, [son of] of Addi, [son of] of Cosam, [son of] of Elmodam, [son of] of Er,

title: Luke 3:29
text: [son of] of Joses, [son of] of Eliezer, [son of] of Jorum, [son of] of Matthat, [son of] of Levi,

title: Luke 3:30
text: [son of] of Simeon, [son of] of Juda, [son of] of Joseph, [son of] of Jonan, [son of] of Eliakim,

title: Luke 3:31
text: [son of] of Melea, the son of Menan, [son of] of Mattatha, [son of] of Nathan, [son of] of David,

title: Luke 3:32
text: [son of] of Jesse, [son of] of Obed, [son of] of Boaz, [son of] of Salma, [son of] of Nahshon,

title: Luke 3:33
text: [son of] of Amminadab, [son of] of Ram, [son of] of Hezron, [son of] of Pharez, [son of] of Judah,

title: Luke 3:34
text: [son of] of Jacob, [son of] of Isaac, [son of] of Abraham, [son of] of Terah, [son of] of Nahor,

title: Luke 3:35
text: [son of] of Serug, [son of] of Reu, [son of] of Peleg, [son of] of Eber, [son of] of Shelah,

title: Luke 3:36
text: [son of] of Cainan, [son of] of Arphaxad, [son of] of Shem, [son of] of Noah, [son of] of Lamech,

title: Luke 3:37
text: [son of] of Methuselah, [son of] of Enoch, [son of] of Jared, [son of] of Mahalaleel, [son of] of Cainan,

title: Luke 3:38
text: [son of] of Enos, [son of] of Seth, [son of] of Adam, [son of] of God.

title: Luke 4:1
text: And Jesus, full of [the] Holy Spirit, returned from Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

title: Luke 4:2
text: forty days, being tempted by the Devil. And in those days He ate nothing. And they being ended, He afterward was hungry.

title: Luke 4:3
text: And the Devil said to Him, If you are the Son of God, speak to this stone that it might become bread.

title: Luke 4:4
text: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written that "man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God."

title: Luke 4:5
text: And the Devil, leading Him up into a high mountain, showed Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

title: Luke 4:6
text: And the Devil said to Him, All this power I will give you, and the glory of them; for it has been delivered to me. And I give it to whomever I will.

title: Luke 4:7
text: Therefore if you will worship me, all shall be yours.

title: Luke 4:8
text: And Jesus answered and said to him, Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, "You shall worship [the] Lord your God, and Him only shall you serve."

title: Luke 4:9
text: And he brought Him to Jerusalem and sat Him on a pinnacle of the temple and said to Him, If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here.

title: Luke 4:10
text: For it is written, "He shall give His angels charge over You, to keep You;

title: Luke 4:11
text: and in [their] hands they shall bear You up, lest at any time You dash Your foot against a stone."

title: Luke 4:12
text: And Jesus answering said to him, It has been said, "You shall not tempt [the] Lord your God."

title: Luke 4:13
text: And when the Devil had ended every temptation, he departed from Him for a time.

title: Luke 4:14
text: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee. And a report went out throughout all the neighborhood concerning Him.

title: Luke 4:15
text: And He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

title: Luke 4:16
text: And He came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. And, as His custom was, He went in to the synagogue on the Sabbath day and stood up to read.

title: Luke 4:17
text: And [the] book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to Him. And unrolling the book, He found the place where it was written,

title: Luke 4:18
text: "The Spirit of [the] Lord [is] on Me; because of this He has anointed Me to proclaim the Gospel to [the] poor. He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim deliverance to the captives, and new sight to [the] blind, to set at liberty those having been crushed,

title: Luke 4:19
text: to proclaim the acceptable year of [the] Lord."

title: Luke 4:20
text: And rolling up the book, returning [it] to the attendant, He sat down. And the eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on Him.

title: Luke 4:21
text: And He began to say to them, Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your ears.

title: Luke 4:22
text: And all bore witness to Him and wondered at the gracious words which came out of His mouth. And they said, Is this not Joseph's son?

title: Luke 4:23
text: And He said to them, You will surely say this proverb to Me, Physician, heal yourself. Whatever [we] have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in your native-place.

title: Luke 4:24
text: And He said, Truly I say to you, No prophet is accepted in his native-place.

title: Luke 4:25
text: But I tell you truly, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land.

title: Luke 4:26
text: But Elijah was not sent to any of them, except to Zarephath, [a city] of Sidon, to a woman, a widow.

title: Luke 4:27
text: And many lepers were in Israel in the [time] of Elisha the prophet, and none of them was cleansed except Naaman the Syrian.

title: Luke 4:28
text: And hearing these things, all in the synagogue were filled [with] wrath.

title: Luke 4:29
text: And they rose up and thrust Him outside the city, and led Him up to the brow of the hill on which their city was built, in order to throw Him down.

title: Luke 4:30
text: But passing through the midst of them, He went away.

title: Luke 4:31
text: And He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them [on] the sabbath days.

title: Luke 4:32
text: And they were astonished at His doctrine, for His word was with authority.

title: Luke 4:33
text: And in the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon and cried out with a loud voice,

title: Luke 4:34
text: saying, Let [us] alone! What is to us and to You, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know You, who You are, the Holy One of God.

title: Luke 4:35
text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Be quiet and come out of him! And when the demon had thrown him into the midst, he came out of him, not harming him.

title: Luke 4:36
text: And they were all amazed and spoke among themselves, saying, What a word [is] this! For with authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out.

title: Luke 4:37
text: And a report about Him went out into every place of the neighborhood.

title: Luke 4:38
text: And rising up from the synagogue, He entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was being seized with a great fever. And they asked Him for her.

title: Luke 4:39
text: And standing over her, He rebuked the fever. And it left her. And immediately she arose and served them.

title: Luke 4:40
text: And the sun sinking, all, as many as had sick ones with different kinds of diseases brought them to Him. And laying hands on each of them, He healed them.

title: Luke 4:41
text: And also demons came out of many, crying out and saying, You are the Christ, the Son of God! And rebuking [them], He did not allow them to speak; for they knew Him to be the Christ.

title: Luke 4:42
text: And day coming on, going out, He went into a deserted place. And the crowds looked for Him and came to Him, and held Him fast, not to pass away from them.

title: Luke 4:43
text: And He said to them, I must proclaim the gospel, the kingdom of God, to other cities, because I was sent on this [mission],

title: Luke 4:44
text: And He proclaimed in the synagogues of Galilee.

title: Luke 5:1
text: And it happened that the crowd pressed on Him to hear the word of God, He stood by the lake of Gennesaret.

title: Luke 5:2
text: And He saw two boats standing by the lake. But the fishermen had left them and were washing [their] nets.

title: Luke 5:3
text: And He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon's, He asked him to thrust out a little from the land. And He sat down and taught the people out of the boat.

title: Luke 5:4
text: And as He stopped speaking, He said to Simon, Launch out into the deep and let your nets down for a haul.

title: Luke 5:5
text: And answering, Simon said to Him, Master, we have toiled all the night and have taken nothing. Yet at Your word I will let down the net.

title: Luke 5:6
text: And doing this, they enclosed a great multitude of fish. And their net was being torn.

title: Luke 5:7
text: And they signaled the partners, those in the other boat, to come and help them. And they came and filled both the boats, so that they were sinking.

title: Luke 5:8
text: And seeing, Simon Peter fell at the knees of Jesus, saying, Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.

title: Luke 5:9
text: For he and all who were with him were astonished at the haul of fish which they had taken,

title: Luke 5:10
text: and so also [were] James and John, [the] sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, Do not fear, from now on you will be taking men alive.

title: Luke 5:11
text: And bringing their boats onto land, forsaking all things, they followed Him.

title: Luke 5:12
text: And it happened, as He was in a certain city, behold, a man full of leprosy! And seeing Jesus, he fell on [his] face and begged Him, saying, Lord, if You will, You can cleanse me.

title: Luke 5:13
text: And stretching out the hand, He touched him, saying, I will! Be clean! And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

title: Luke 5:14
text: And He commanded him, Tell no one, but go and show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing, as Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

title: Luke 5:15
text: But the word about Him spread even more. And great crowds were coming to hear, and to be healed from their infirmities by Him.

title: Luke 5:16
text: But He was drawing back in the wilderness, and praying.

title: Luke 5:17
text: And it happened on one of the days, even He was teaching. And Pharisees and teachers of [the] Law were sitting by, who had come out of every village of Galilee and Judea and Jerusalem. And [the] power of [the] Lord was there, for the curing [of] them.

title: Luke 5:18
text: And behold, men carrying, on a cot, a man who was paralyzed. And they sought to bring him in and to lay [him] before Him.

title: Luke 5:19
text: And not finding a way by [which] they might bring him in through the crowd, going up on the housetop, they let him down through the tiles with his cot into the midst, before Jesus.

title: Luke 5:20
text: And seeing their faith, He said to him, Man, your sins are forgiven you.

title: Luke 5:21
text: And the scribes and Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, except God alone?

title: Luke 5:22
text: But knowing their thoughts, answering, Jesus said to them, Why do you reason in your hearts?

title: Luke 5:23
text: Which is easier, to say, Your sins are forgiven you; or to say, Rise up and walk?

title: Luke 5:24
text: But so that you may know that the Son of man has authority on earth to forgive sins, He said to the paralytic, I say to you, Arise, and take up your cot [and] go to your house.

title: Luke 5:25
text: And immediately he rose up before them and took up [that] on which he lay. And he departed to his own house, glorifying God.

title: Luke 5:26
text: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God and were filled [with] fear, saying, We saw wonderful things today.

title: Luke 5:27
text: And after these things He went out and saw a tax-collector named Levi, sitting at the tax-office. And [He] said to him, Follow Me.

title: Luke 5:28
text: And leaving all, he rose up and followed Him.

title: Luke 5:29
text: And Levi made a great feast in his own house for Him. And there was a great company of tax-collectors and of others who were reclining with them.

title: Luke 5:30
text: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against His disciples, saying, Why do you eat and drink with tax-collectors and sinners?

title: Luke 5:31
text: And Jesus answered and said to them, Those who are sound do not need a physician, but those who are sick.

title: Luke 5:32
text: I did not come to call the righteous to repentance, but sinners.

title: Luke 5:33
text: And they said to Him, Why do John's disciples fast often and make prayers, and also [the disciples] of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?

title: Luke 5:34
text: But He said to them, Can you make the sons of the bridechamber fast while the bridegroom is with them?

title: Luke 5:35
text: But the days will come when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then they shall fast in those days.

title: Luke 5:36
text: And He also spoke a parable to them: No one puts a piece of a new garment on an old garment. Otherwise, both the new will tear, and [the old] does not match [the] piece from the new.

title: Luke 5:37
text: And no one puts new wine into old wineskins. Else the new wine will burst the wineskins and be spilled, and the wineskin will perish.

title: Luke 5:38
text: But new wine must be put into new wineskins, and both are preserved together.

title: Luke 5:39
text: Also no one having drunk old [wine] immediately desires new, for he says, The old is better.

title: Luke 6:1
text: And it happened on the second chief sabbath, He went through the grain fields. And His disciples plucked the heads [of grain] and ate, rubbing [them] in their hands.

title: Luke 6:2
text: And certain of the Pharisees said to them, Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

title: Luke 6:3
text: And answering, Jesus said to them, Have you not read this, what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him;

title: Luke 6:4
text: how he went into the house of God and took the showbread, and ate (and also gave to those who were with him) which it is not lawful to eat, except for the priests alone?

title: Luke 6:5
text: And He said to them, The Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

title: Luke 6:6
text: And it happened, also on another sabbath, that He entered into the synagogue and taught. And there was a man whose right hand was withered.

title: Luke 6:7
text: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him [to see] if He would heal on the sabbath day, so that they might find an accusation against Him.

title: Luke 6:8
text: But He knew their thoughts and said to the man who had the withered hand, Rise up and stand in the middle. And he arose and stood.

title: Luke 6:9
text: Then Jesus said to them, I will ask you one thing: Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil, to save life, or to destroy [it]?

title: Luke 6:10
text: And looking around on them all, He said to the man, Stretch out your hand! And he did so. And his hand was restored whole like the other.

title: Luke 6:11
text: And they were filled [with] madness, and talked with one another [as to] what they might do to Jesus.

title: Luke 6:12
text: And it happened in those days that He went out into a mountain to pray, and He was spending the night in prayer to God.

title: Luke 6:13
text: And when it was day, He called His disciples. And He chose twelve of them, whom He also named apostles:

title: Luke 6:14
text: Simon, whom He also named Peter, and Andrew his brother; James and John; Philip and Bartholomew;

title: Luke 6:15
text: Matthew and Thomas; James [the son] of Alpheus, and Simon who was called Zelotes;

title: Luke 6:16
text: Judas [the brother] of James, and Judas Iscariot, who also became [the] betrayer.

title: Luke 6:17
text: And coming down with them, He stood on a level place. And a crowd of His disciples, and a great multitude of people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon (who came to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases) were there;

title: Luke 6:18
text: also those tormented by unclean spirits; and they were healed.

title: Luke 6:19
text: And all the crowd sought to touch Him, for power went out of Him and healed [them] all.

title: Luke 6:20
text: And lifting up His eyes to His disciples, He said, Blessed [are] the poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 6:21
text: Blessed [are] you who hunger now, for you shall be filled. Blessed [are you] who weep now, for you shall laugh.

title: Luke 6:22
text: Blessed [are] you when men shall hate you, and when they shall cut you off, and when they shall reproach [you] and shall cast out your name as evil, for the sake of the Son of man.

title: Luke 6:23
text: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy. For behold, your reward [is] great in Heaven. For so their fathers did according to these things to the prophets.

title: Luke 6:24
text: But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

title: Luke 6:25
text: Woe to you who are full! For you shall hunger. Woe to you who laugh now! For you shall mourn and weep.

title: Luke 6:26
text: Woe to you when all men shall speak well [of] you! For so their fathers did to the false prophets.

title: Luke 6:27
text: But I say to you who hear: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

title: Luke 6:28
text: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who despitefully use you.

title: Luke 6:29
text: And to him who strikes you on the [one] cheek, also offer the other. And to him who takes away your garment, do not forbid your tunic also.

title: Luke 6:30
text: Give to everyone who asks of you, and from him who takes away your goods, do not ask [them] again.

title: Luke 6:31
text: And as you desire that men should do to you, you do also to them likewise.

title: Luke 6:32
text: For if you love those who love you, what thanks do you have? For sinners also love those who love them.

title: Luke 6:33
text: And if you do good to those who do good to you, what thanks do you have? For sinners also do the same.

title: Luke 6:34
text: And if you lend [to those] of whom you hope to receive, what thanks do you have? For sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

title: Luke 6:35
text: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing [in return]. And your reward shall be great, and you shall be the sons of the Highest. For He is kind to the unthankful and [to] the evil.

title: Luke 6:36
text: Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is merciful.

title: Luke 6:37
text: Judge not, and you shall not be judged. Condemn not, and you shall not be condemned. Forgive, and you shall be forgiven.

title: Luke 6:38
text: Give, and it shall be given to you, good measure pressed down and shaken together and running over, they shall give into your bosom. For with the same measure that you measure, it shall be measured to you again.

title: Luke 6:39
text: And He spoke a parable to them: Can the blind lead the blind? Shall they not both fall into the ditch?

title: Luke 6:40
text: The disciple is not above his master, but everyone who is perfect shall be like his master.

title: Luke 6:41
text: And why do you look at the splinter that is in your brother's eye, but do not see the beam that is in [your] own eye?

title: Luke 6:42
text: Or how can you say to your brother, Brother, let me pull out the splinter in your eye, when you yourself do not see the beam that is in your own eye? Hypocrite! First cast out the beam out of your own eye, and then you shall see clearly to pull out the splinter that is in your brother's eye.

title: Luke 6:43
text: For a good tree does not bring forth corrupt fruit, neither does a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

title: Luke 6:44
text: For every tree is known by [its] own fruit. For men do not gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

title: Luke 6:45
text: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth the good. And an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings forth the evil. For out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.

title: Luke 6:46
text: And why do you call Me Lord, Lord, and do not do what I say?

title: Luke 6:47
text: Whoever comes to Me and hears My words, and does them, I will show you to whom he is like.

title: Luke 6:48
text: He is like a man who built a house and dug deep and laid the foundation on a rock; and a flood occurring, the stream burst against that house and could not shake it; for it was founded on a rock.

title: Luke 6:49
text: But he who hears and does not perform, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, on which the stream burst, and immediately it fell. And the ruin of that house was great.

title: Luke 7:1
text: And when He had ended all His words in the ears of the people, He entered into Capernaum.

title: Luke 7:2
text: And a certain servant of a centurion who was dear to him, was sick and ready to die.

title: Luke 7:3
text: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent the elders of the Jews to Him, begging Him that He would come and heal his servant.

title: Luke 7:4
text: And coming to Jesus, they begged Him earnestly, saying that he was worthy, he for whom You give this;

title: Luke 7:5
text: for, [they said], He loves our nation, and he has built us a synagogue.

title: Luke 7:6
text: Then Jesus went with them. But He being yet not far off from the house, the centurion sent friends to Him, saying to Him, Lord, do not trouble Yourself. For I am not worthy that You should enter under my roof.

title: Luke 7:7
text: Therefore neither did I think myself worthy to come to You; but say a word, and my servant will be healed.

title: Luke 7:8
text: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers. And I say to one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does [it].

title: Luke 7:9
text: And hearing these things, Jesus marveled at him. And turning to the crowd following Him, He said, I say to you, I have not found such faith, no, not in Israel.

title: Luke 7:10
text: And they who were sent, returning to the house, found the sick servant well.

title: Luke 7:11
text: And it happened on the next day, He went into a city called Nain. And many of His disciples and a great crowd went with Him.

title: Luke 7:12
text: And drawing near the gate of the city, even behold, one having died was being carried out, an only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a considerable crowd of the city was with her.

title: Luke 7:13
text: And when the Lord saw her, He had compassion on her and said to her, Do not weep.

title: Luke 7:14
text: And He came and touched the bier. And the ones who bore [him] stood still. And He said, Young man, I say to you, Arise!

title: Luke 7:15
text: And the one who was dead sat up and began to speak. And He delivered him to his mother.

title: Luke 7:16
text: And fear came on all. And they glorified God, saying, A great prophet has risen up among us; and, God has visited His people.

title: Luke 7:17
text: And this report of Him went out in all Judea, and in all the neighborhood.

title: Luke 7:18
text: And his disciples reported all these things to John.

title: Luke 7:19
text: And John, calling near a certain two of his disciples, sent [them] to Jesus, saying, Are You He that should come, or do we look for another?

title: Luke 7:20
text: And coming to Him, the men said, John the Baptist has sent us to You, saying, Are You He who should come, or do we look for another?

title: Luke 7:21
text: And in the same hour He cured many of infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits. And He gave sight to many who were blind.

title: Luke 7:22
text: And answering, Jesus said to them, Go and tell John what you have seen and heard; that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the gospel is proclaimed to the poor.

title: Luke 7:23
text: And blessed is [he] who shall not be offended in Me.

title: Luke 7:24
text: And when the messengers of John had departed, He began to speak to the people concerning John. What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

title: Luke 7:25
text: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed with soft clothing? Behold, those in splendid clothing and being in luxury are in kings' palaces.

title: Luke 7:26
text: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I say to you, and much more than a prophet.

title: Luke 7:27
text: This is [he] of whom it is written, "Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, who shall prepare Your way before You."

title: Luke 7:28
text: For I say to you, Among [those] who are born of woman there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist. But he who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

title: Luke 7:29
text: And all the people and the tax-collectors who heard [Him] justified God, being baptized [with] the baptism of John.

title: Luke 7:30
text: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, not being baptized by him.

title: Luke 7:31
text: And the Lord said, To what then shall I compare the men of this generation? And to what are they like?

title: Luke 7:32
text: They are like children sitting in a market and calling to one another, and saying, We have played the flute to you, and you have not danced; we have mourned to you, and you did not weep.

title: Luke 7:33
text: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, He has a demon.

title: Luke 7:34
text: The Son of man has come eating and drinking, and you say, Behold a gluttonous man and a winebibber, a friend of tax-collectors and sinners!

title: Luke 7:35
text: But wisdom has been justified by all her children.

title: Luke 7:36
text: And one of the Pharisees asked Him to eat with him. And going into the Pharisee's house, He reclined.

title: Luke 7:37
text: And behold, a woman, a sinner in the city, knowing that He reclined in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster vial of ointment.

title: Luke 7:38
text: And she stood behind [Him], weeping at His feet, and she began to wash His feet with tears and wipe them with the hair of her head. And [she] ardently kissed His feet and anointed [them] with the ointment.

title: Luke 7:39
text: But seeing this, the Pharisee who had invited Him, spoke within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what kind of woman [this is] who touches him, for she is a sinner.

title: Luke 7:40
text: And answering, Jesus said to him, Simon, I have something to say to you. And he said, Teacher, speak.

title: Luke 7:41
text: There was a certain creditor who had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and [the] other fifty.

title: Luke 7:42
text: And they having nothing to pay, he freely forgave both. Then which of them do [you] say will love him most?

title: Luke 7:43
text: And answering, Simon said, I suppose that one to whom he forgave most. And He said to him, You have judged rightly.

title: Luke 7:44
text: And He turned to the woman and said to Simon, Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, yet you gave Me no water for My feet. But she has washed My feet with tears, and has wiped [them] with the hair of her head.

title: Luke 7:45
text: You gave Me no kiss, but this woman, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss My feet.

title: Luke 7:46
text: You did not anoint My head with oil, but this woman has anointed My feet with ointment.

title: Luke 7:47
text: Therefore I say to you, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, he loves little.

title: Luke 7:48
text: And He said to her, Your sins are forgiven.

title: Luke 7:49
text: And those reclining with [Him] began to say within themselves, Who is this who even forgives sins?

title: Luke 7:50
text: And He said to the woman, Your faith has saved you, go in peace.

title: Luke 8:1
text: And it happened afterwards, He traveled in every city and village, proclaiming and announcing the gospel of the kingdom of God. And the Twelve [were] with Him,

title: Luke 8:2
text: and also certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities; Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven demons,

title: Luke 8:3
text: and Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, who ministered to Him of their possessions.

title: Luke 8:4
text: And a great crowd coming together, and those in each city coming to Him, He spoke by a parable:

title: Luke 8:5
text: A sower went out to sow his seed. And as he sowed, the one fell by the roadside and was trampled; and the birds of the air devoured it.

title: Luke 8:6
text: And other fell on a rock, and sprouting, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

title: Luke 8:7
text: And other fell amidst thorns, and springing up with the thorns, [they] choked it.

title: Luke 8:8
text: And other fell on good ground and sprang up, and bore fruit a hundredfold. And when He had said these things, He cried, He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

title: Luke 8:9
text: And His disciples asked Him, saying, What might this parable be?

title: Luke 8:10
text: And He said, To you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God. But to others I speak in parables, so that seeing they might not see and hearing they might not understand.

title: Luke 8:11
text: And the parable is this: The seed is the Word of God.

title: Luke 8:12
text: Those by the roadside are the ones who hear; then the Devil comes and takes the Word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

title: Luke 8:13
text: Those on the rock [are] the ones who, when they hear, receive the Word with joy. And these have no root, who for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

title: Luke 8:14
text: And those which fell among thorns are the ones who, when they have heard, go forth and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of life, and do not bear to maturity.

title: Luke 8:15
text: But those on the good ground are the ones who, in an honest and good heart, having heard the Word, keep [it] and bring forth fruit with patience.

title: Luke 8:16
text: And no one lighting a lamp covers it with a vessel or puts [it] under a couch; but he sets [it] on a lampstand so that those who enter in may see the light.

title: Luke 8:17
text: For nothing is secret that shall not be revealed; nor secret which shall not be known and come to be revealed.

title: Luke 8:18
text: Therefore be careful how you hear. For whoever has, to him shall be given; and whoever has not, from him shall be taken even that which he seems to have.

title: Luke 8:19
text: And His mother and [His] brothers came to Him. And they could not come near Him because of the crowd.

title: Luke 8:20
text: And it was told to Him [by some], who said, Your mother and Your brothers are standing outside desiring to see You.

title: Luke 8:21
text: And He answered and said to them, My mother and My brothers are those who hear the Word of God and do it.

title: Luke 8:22
text: And it happened on a certain day that He went into a boat with His disciples. And He said to them, Let us go over to the other side of the lake. And they put out to sea.

title: Luke 8:23
text: But as they sailed, He fell asleep. And a storm of wind came onto the lake. And they were being filled [with water] and were in jeopardy.

title: Luke 8:24
text: And they came to Him and awakened Him, saying, Master, Master, we are perishing! Then being aroused, He rebuked the wind and the raging of the water. And they ceased, and there was a calm.

title: Luke 8:25
text: And He said to them, Where is your faith? And being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, Who then is this One? For He commands even the winds and water, and they obey Him!

title: Luke 8:26
text: And they sailed down to the country of the Gadarenes, which is across from Galilee.

title: Luke 8:27
text: And He going out onto land, He met a certain man out of the city, who had had demons a long time, and put on no clothes, nor stayed in a house, but among the tombs.

title: Luke 8:28
text: And seeing Jesus, he cried out and fell down before Him and said with a loud voice, What is to me and to You, Jesus, Son of God the Most High? I beseech You, Do not torment me!

title: Luke 8:29
text: (For He had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had seized him. And he had been kept bound in chains and in fetters, and he broke the bands and was driven into the deserted [places] by the demons.)

title: Luke 8:30
text: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is your name? And he said, Legion; because many demons had entered into him.

title: Luke 8:31
text: And they begged Him that He would not command them to go out into the abyss.

title: Luke 8:32
text: And there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain. And they begged Him that He would allow them to enter into them. And He allowed them.

title: Luke 8:33
text: And coming out of the man, the demons entered into the pigs. And the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake and were choked.

title: Luke 8:34
text: And those feeding [the pigs], and seeing the thing, fled. And leaving, [they] reported to the city and to the farms.

title: Luke 8:35
text: And they went out to see what had been done. And they came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had departed sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind. And they were afraid.

title: Luke 8:36
text: Also those who saw [it] told them how the demon-possessed one was healed.

title: Luke 8:37
text: And all the multitude of the neighborhood of the Gadarenes were seized with a great fear, and asked Him to depart from them. And entering into the boat, He returned.

title: Luke 8:38
text: And the man out of whom the demons had gone out begged Him, [desiring] to be with Him. But Jesus sent him away, saying,

title: Luke 8:39
text: Return to your own house and declare what God has done to you. And he went his way and proclaimed throughout all the city what [great] things Jesus had done to him.

title: Luke 8:40
text: And it happened when Jesus had returned, the people received Him. For they were all waiting for Him.

title: Luke 8:41
text: And behold, a man named Jairus came, and he was a synagogue-ruler. And he fell down at Jesus' feet and begged Him that He would come into his house.

title: Luke 8:42
text: For he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay dying. But as He went, the people thronged Him.

title: Luke 8:43
text: And a woman who had a flow of blood twelve years (who had spent all her living on physicians, [and] could not be healed by any)

title: Luke 8:44
text: came behind [Him] and touched the border of His garment. And instantly her flow of blood was staunched.

title: Luke 8:45
text: And Jesus said, Who touched Me? And all having denied, Peter and those with Him said, Master, the crowd presses and jostles You, and You say, Who touched Me?

title: Luke 8:46
text: And Jesus said, Someone has touched Me, for I know that power has gone out of Me.

title: Luke 8:47
text: And seeing that she was not hidden, the woman came trembling. And falling down before Him, she declared to Him before all the people why she had touched Him, and how she was instantly healed.

title: Luke 8:48
text: And He said to her, Daughter, be comforted. Your faith has saved you; go in peace.

title: Luke 8:49
text: He was still speaking when someone came from the synagogue-ruler, saying to him, Your daughter is dead, do not trouble the Teacher.

title: Luke 8:50
text: But when Jesus heard, He answered Him, saying, Do not fear, only believe and she shall be healed.

title: Luke 8:51
text: And coming into the house, He allowed no one to go in, except Peter and James and John, and the father and the mother of the girl.

title: Luke 8:52
text: And all were weeping and bewailing her. But He said, Do not weep; she has not died, but sleeps.

title: Luke 8:53
text: And they ridiculed, knowing that she was dead.

title: Luke 8:54
text: And He put them all out. And He took her by the hand and called, saying, Little girl, arise!

title: Luke 8:55
text: And her spirit came again, and she arose immediately. And He commanded that [food] be given her to eat.

title: Luke 8:56
text: And her parents were astonished. But He charged them to tell no one the thing that happened.

title: Luke 9:1
text: And He called His twelve disciples together and gave them power and authority over all demons and to cure diseases.

title: Luke 9:2
text: And [He] sent them to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.

title: Luke 9:3
text: And He said to them, Take nothing for [your] journey, neither staffs, nor a bag, nor bread, nor money, nor each to have two tunics.

title: Luke 9:4
text: And whatever house you enter into, abide there and depart from there.

title: Luke 9:5
text: And whoever will not receive you, when you go out of that city shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

title: Luke 9:6
text: And they departed and went through the towns, proclaiming the gospel and healing everywhere.

title: Luke 9:7
text: And Herod the tetrarch heard of all the things happening by Him. And he was perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from [the] dead;

title: Luke 9:8
text: and by some, that Elijah had appeared; and by others, that one of the old prophets had risen again.

title: Luke 9:9
text: And Herod said, John I have beheaded, but who is this of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see Him.

title: Luke 9:10
text: And returning, the apostles told Him all that they had done. And He took them and went aside privately into a deserted place of a city called Bethsaida.

title: Luke 9:11
text: But knowing [this], the crowds followed Him. And He received them and spoke to them of the kingdom of God, and He healed those who had need of healing.

title: Luke 9:12
text: But the day began to wear away, and coming up the Twelve said to Him, Send the crowd away so that they may go into the villages and farms all around, and lodge, and get food. For we are here in a deserted place.

title: Luke 9:13
text: But He said to them, You give them [something] to eat. And they said, We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we go and buy food for all these people.

title: Luke 9:14
text: (For they were about five thousand men.) And He said to His disciples, Make them recline by fifties in a company.

title: Luke 9:15
text: And they did so, and made them all recline.

title: Luke 9:16
text: And He took the five loaves and the two fish. And looking up to Heaven, He blessed them and broke, and He gave to the disciples to set before the crowd.

title: Luke 9:17
text: And they ate and were all filled. And there was taken up twelve hand baskets full of fragments of that left over to them.

title: Luke 9:18
text: And it happened [as] He was alone praying, the disciples were with Him. And He asked them, saying, Whom do the crowds say that I am?

title: Luke 9:19
text: Answering, they said, John the Baptist; but some [say], Elijah, and others say that one of the old prophets has risen again.

title: Luke 9:20
text: He said to them, But who do you say that I am? Answering, Peter said, The Christ of God.

title: Luke 9:21
text: And He strictly charged them and commanded to tell no one this,

title: Luke 9:22
text: saying, The Son of man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.

title: Luke 9:23
text: And He said to all, If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.

title: Luke 9:24
text: For whoever will save his life shall lose it, but whoever will lose his life for My sake, he shall save it.

title: Luke 9:25
text: For what is a man profited if he gains the whole world and loses himself, or is cast away?

title: Luke 9:26
text: For whoever shall be ashamed of Me and of My words, the Son of man shall be ashamed of him when He shall come in His own and [in His] Father's glory, and that of the holy angels.

title: Luke 9:27
text: But I tell you truly, there are some standing here who shall not taste of death until they see the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 9:28
text: And about eight days after these sayings, He took Peter and John and James and went up into a mountain to pray.

title: Luke 9:29
text: And as He prayed, the appearance of His countenance was altered, and His clothing [was] dazzling white.

title: Luke 9:30
text: And behold, two men talked with Him, who were Moses and Elijah,

title: Luke 9:31
text: who appeared in glory and spoke of His exodus, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

title: Luke 9:32
text: But Peter and those with him were heavy with sleep. But fully awakening, they saw His glory, and the two men who stood with Him.

title: Luke 9:33
text: And in their parting from Him, it happened that Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for [us] to be here. And let us make three tabernacles, one for You and one for Moses and one for Elijah; not knowing what he said.

title: Luke 9:34
text: And as he was saying these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them. And they feared [as] they entered into the cloud.

title: Luke 9:35
text: And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is My Son, the Beloved, hear Him.

title: Luke 9:36
text: And when the voice occurred, Jesus was found alone. And they were silent, and told no one in those days anything which they had seen.

title: Luke 9:37
text: And it happened on the next day, they coming down from the mountain, a huge crowd met Him.

title: Luke 9:38
text: And behold, a man cried aloud from the crowd, saying, Teacher, I beseech You, look on my son, for he is my only-born son.

title: Luke 9:39
text: And lo, a spirit takes him, and [he] suddenly cries out. And [it] throws him into convulsions, with foaming, and with pain departs from him, bruising him.

title: Luke 9:40
text: And I begged Your disciples to cast him out, and they could not.

title: Luke 9:41
text: And answering, Jesus said, O unbelieving generation, [one] having been perverted, how long shall I be with you and endure you? Bring your son here.

title: Luke 9:42
text: And as [he] was still coming, the demon violently convulsed and tore [him]. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit and healed the child and delivered him again to his father.

title: Luke 9:43
text: And they were all amazed at the majesty of God. But as all were marveling at all things which Jesus did, He said to His disciples,

title: Luke 9:44
text: Let these words sink down into your ears. For the Son of man shall be betrayed into [the] hands of men.

title: Luke 9:45
text: But they did not understand this thing, and it was hidden from them so that they did not perceive it. And they feared to ask Him of this word.

title: Luke 9:46
text: And an argument came in among them, who might be [the] greater of them.

title: Luke 9:47
text: And seeing the argument of their heart, Jesus took a child and set him beside Him.

title: Luke 9:48
text: And He said to them, Whoever shall receive this child in My name receives Me. And whoever shall receive Me receives Him who sent Me. For he who is least among you all, he shall be great.

title: Luke 9:49
text: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out demons in Your name. And we prevented him, because he does not follow us.

title: Luke 9:50
text: And Jesus said to him, Do not prevent [him], for he who is not against us is for us.

title: Luke 9:51
text: And it happened in the fulfilling [of] the days of His taking up, He steadfastly set His face to go to Jerusalem.

title: Luke 9:52
text: And [He] sent messengers before His face. And they went and entered into a village of the Samaritans to make ready for Him.

title: Luke 9:53
text: And they did not receive Him, because His face was going toward Jerusalem.

title: Luke 9:54
text: And seeing, His disciples James and John said, Lord, do You desire [that] we command fire to come down from Heaven and consume them, even as Elijah did?

title: Luke 9:55
text: But He turned and rebuked them and said, You do not know of what spirit you are.

title: Luke 9:56
text: For the Son of man has not come to destroy men's lives, but to save. And they went to another village.

title: Luke 9:57
text: And it happened as they were going in the way, one said to Him, Lord, I will follow You wherever You go.

title: Luke 9:58
text: And Jesus said to him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air [have] nests, but the Son of man has nowhere to lay [His] head.

title: Luke 9:59
text: And He said to another, Follow Me! But he said, Lord, first allow me to go and bury my father.

title: Luke 9:60
text: Jesus said to him, Let the dead bury their dead, but you go and proclaim the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 9:61
text: And another also said, Lord, I will follow You, but first allow me to take leave of those in my house.

title: Luke 9:62
text: And Jesus said to him, No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 10:1
text: And after these things the Lord appointed seventy others, And He sent them two and two before His face into every city and place where He was about to come.

title: Luke 10:2
text: Then He said to them, The harvest truly [is] great, but the laborers [are] few. Therefore pray [to] the Lord of the harvest that He may send forth laborers into His harvest.

title: Luke 10:3
text: Go! Behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

title: Luke 10:4
text: Carry neither purse nor bag nor sandals. And greet no one by the way.

title: Luke 10:5
text: And into whatever house you enter, first say, Peace to this house.

title: Luke 10:6
text: And if a son of peace is there, your peace shall rest on it. If not, it shall return to you,

title: Luke 10:7
text: And remain in the same house, eating and drinking the things [shared] by them; for the laborer is worthy of his hire. Do not move from house to house.

title: Luke 10:8
text: And into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you.

title: Luke 10:9
text: And heal the sick that are in it, and say to them, The kingdom of God has come near you!

title: Luke 10:10
text: And into whatever city you enter, and they do not receive you, going out into the streets say,

title: Luke 10:11
text: Even the dust of your city which clings to us, we wipe off against you. Yet be sure of this, that the kingdom of God has come near you.

title: Luke 10:12
text: But I say to you that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

title: Luke 10:13
text: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works which have been done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented a long while ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

title: Luke 10:14
text: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the Judgment than for you.

title: Luke 10:15
text: And you, Capernaum, which has been lifted up to Heaven, you shall be thrust down into hell.

title: Luke 10:16
text: The one hearing you hears Me, and he who despises you despises Me; he who rejects you [also] rejects Him who sent Me.

title: Luke 10:17
text: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the demons are subject to us through Your name.

title: Luke 10:18
text: And He said to them, I saw Satan fall from Heaven like lightning.

title: Luke 10:19
text: Behold, I give to you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the authority of the enemy. And nothing shall by any means hurt you.

title: Luke 10:20
text: Yet do not rejoice in this, that the [evil] spirits are subject to you, rather rejoice because your names are written in Heaven.

title: Luke 10:21
text: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in Spirit and said, I thank You, Father, Lord of Heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from [the] sophisticated and cunning, and have revealed them to babes. Yes, Father, for so it was pleasing before You.

title: Luke 10:22
text: All things are delivered to Me by My Father; and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son, and the one to whom the Son will reveal [Him].

title: Luke 10:23
text: And He turned to [His] disciples and said privately, Blessed [are] the eyes which see the things that you see.

title: Luke 10:24
text: For I tell you that many prophets and kings have desired to see what you see, and have not seen [them], and to hear what you hear, and have not heard [them].

title: Luke 10:25
text: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tempted Him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

title: Luke 10:26
text: He said to him, What is written in the law? How do you read it?

title: Luke 10:27
text: And answering, he said, You shall love [the] Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength, and with all your mind, and your neighbor as yourself.

title: Luke 10:28
text: And He said to him, You have answered right, do this and you shall live.

title: Luke 10:29
text: But he, willing to justify himself, said to Jesus, And who is my neighbor?

title: Luke 10:30
text: And answering, Jesus said, A certain [man] went down from Jerusalem to Jericho and fell among robbers, who stripped him of his clothing and wounded him, and departed, leaving [him] half dead.

title: Luke 10:31
text: And by coincidence a certain priest came down that way and seeing him, he passed by on the opposite [side].

title: Luke 10:32
text: And in the same way a Levite, also being at the place, coming and seeing [him], he passed on the opposite [side].

title: Luke 10:33
text: But a certain traveling Samaritan came upon him, and seeing him, he was filled with pity.

title: Luke 10:34
text: And coming near, [he] bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine, and set him on his own animal and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

title: Luke 10:35
text: And going on the next day, he took out two denarii and gave [them] to the innkeeper, and said to him, Take care of him. And whatever more you spend, when I come again I will repay you.

title: Luke 10:36
text: Then which of these three, do you think, was neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?

title: Luke 10:37
text: And he said, The [one] doing the [deed of] mercy to him. And Jesus said to him, Go and do likewise.

title: Luke 10:38
text: And as they went, it happened that He entered into a certain village. And a certain woman named Martha received Him into her house.

title: Luke 10:39
text: And she had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus' feet [and] heard His word.

title: Luke 10:40
text: But Martha was distracted with much serving. And she came to Him and said, Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Therefore tell her to help me.

title: Luke 10:41
text: And Jesus answered and said to her, Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things.

title: Luke 10:42
text: But one thing is needful, and Mary has chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

title: Luke 11:1
text: And it happened [as] He was praying in a certain place, when He ceased, one of His disciples said to Him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught His disciples.

title: Luke 11:2
text: And He said to them, When you pray, say: Our Father, who [is] in Heaven, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come, Your will be done, as in Heaven, so also on the earth.

title: Luke 11:3
text: Give us day by day our daily bread,

title: Luke 11:4
text: and forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.

title: Luke 11:5
text: And He said to them, which of you shall have a friend and shall go to him at midnight and say to him, Friend, lend me three loaves,

title: Luke 11:6
text: for a friend of mine has come from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him?

title: Luke 11:7
text: And he answering from inside may say, Do not trouble me. The door is now shut and my children are in bed with me. I cannot rise and give to you.

title: Luke 11:8
text: I say to you, though he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will arise and give him as many as he needs.

title: Luke 11:9
text: And I say to you, Ask and it shall be given you. Seek and you shall find. Knock and it shall be opened to you.

title: Luke 11:10
text: For everyone who asks receives. And he who seeks finds. And to him who knocks it shall be opened.

title: Luke 11:11
text: For what father of you, [if] the son asks [for] bread, will he give him a stone? Or if [he asks] for a fish, will he give him a snake for a fish?

title: Luke 11:12
text: Or if he shall ask for an egg, will he give him a scorpion?

title: Luke 11:13
text: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more shall [your] heavenly Father give [the] Holy Spirit to those who ask Him?

title: Luke 11:14
text: And He was casting out a demon, and it was dumb. And it happened as the demon [was] going out, the dumb one spoke. And the people marveled.

title: Luke 11:15
text: But some of them said, He casts out demons through Beelzebub the chief of the demons.

title: Luke 11:16
text: And others, tempting [Him], sought a sign from Heaven from him.

title: Luke 11:17
text: But knowing their thoughts, He said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. And a house [divided] against a house falls.

title: Luke 11:18
text: If Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons through Beelzebub.

title: Luke 11:19
text: And if I cast out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your sons cast [them] out? Therefore they shall be your judges.

title: Luke 11:20
text: But if I cast out demons with [the] finger of God, no doubt the kingdom of God has come on you.

title: Luke 11:21
text: When the strong man, fully armed, guards his dwelling, his goods are in peace.

title: Luke 11:22
text: But when one stronger than he comes, he overcomes him. He takes from him all his armor in which he trusted, and he distributes his arms.

title: Luke 11:23
text: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.

title: Luke 11:24
text: When the unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he walks through dry places seeking rest. And finding none, he says, I will return to my house from which I came out.

title: Luke 11:25
text: And when he comes, he finds [it] swept and decorated.

title: Luke 11:26
text: And he goes and takes seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and entering in, they dwell there. And the last state of that man is worse than the first.

title: Luke 11:27
text: And it happened [as] He spoke these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice [and] said to Him, Blessed [is] the womb that bore You, and [the] breasts which You have sucked.

title: Luke 11:28
text: But He said, No; rather, blessed [are] they who hear the Word of God and keep it.

title: Luke 11:29
text: But the crowds pressing on [Him], He began to say, This is an evil generation. It seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it, except the sign of Jonah the prophet.

title: Luke 11:30
text: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also shall the Son of man be to this generation.

title: Luke 11:31
