text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the Judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them. For she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon. And behold, One greater than Solomon [is] here.

title: Luke 11:32
text: The men of Nineveh shall rise up in the Judgment with this generation and shall condemn it. For they repented at the preaching of Jonah. And behold, One greater than Jonah [is] here.

title: Luke 11:33
text: No one, when he has lighted a lamp, puts [it] in a secret place, or under a grain-measure, but on a lampstand, so that they who come in may see the light.

title: Luke 11:34
text: The light of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is sound, your whole body also is [full of] light. But when [your eye] is evil, your body also [is full of] darkness.

title: Luke 11:35
text: Therefore take heed that the light in you is not darkness.

title: Luke 11:36
text: Therefore if your whole body [is] full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be [full of] light, as when the shining of a lamp enlightens you.

title: Luke 11:37
text: And [as He spoke], a certain Pharisee asked Him to dine with him. And He went in and reclined.

title: Luke 11:38
text: And when the Pharisee saw [it], he was amazed that He had not first washed before dinner.

title: Luke 11:39
text: And the Lord said to him, Now you Pharisees make the outside of the cup and the platter clean, but your inward part is full of plunder and wickedness.

title: Luke 11:40
text: Fools! Did not He who made the outside also make the inside?

title: Luke 11:41
text: But give alms [of] such things as you have, and behold, all things [are] clean to you.

title: Luke 11:42
text: But woe to you, Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, and pass over judgment and the love of God. You ought to have done these, and not to leave the other undone.

title: Luke 11:43
text: Woe to you, Pharisees! For you love the chief seats in the synagogues and greetings in the markets.

title: Luke 11:44
text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like unseen tombs and the men walking above are not aware of them.

title: Luke 11:45
text: And one of the lawyers answered and said to Him, Master, you reproach us also when you say this.

title: Luke 11:46
text: And He said, Woe to you also, lawyers! For you load men with burdens grievous to be carried, and [you] yourselves do not touch the burdens with one of your fingers.

title: Luke 11:47
text: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

title: Luke 11:48
text: Truly you bear witness that you consent to the deeds of your fathers. For they indeed killed them, and you build their tombs.

title: Luke 11:49
text: Therefore the wisdom of God also said, I will send them prophets and apostles, and [some] of them they shall slay and persecute,

title: Luke 11:50
text: so that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from [the] foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

title: Luke 11:51
text: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, [who] perished between the altar and the temple. Truly I say to you, It shall be required of this generation.

title: Luke 11:52
text: Woe to you, lawyers! For you have taken away the key of knowledge. You did not enter in yourselves, and you have hindered those who were entering in.

title: Luke 11:53
text: And as He said these things to them, the scribes and Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw [Him] out concerning many things,

title: Luke 11:54
text: lying in ambush for Him, and seeking to catch something out of His mouth, so that they might accuse Him.

title: Luke 12:1
text: In the meantime, when there had gathered together an innumerable crowd of people, so as to trample on one another, He began to say to His disciples first, Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

title: Luke 12:2
text: For there is nothing covered that shall not be revealed, nor anything hidden that shall not be known.

title: Luke 12:3
text: Therefore whatever you have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light. And that which you have spoken in the ear in secret rooms shall be proclaimed on the housetops.

title: Luke 12:4
text: And I say to you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

title: Luke 12:5
text: But I will warn you of whom you shall fear: Fear Him who, after He has killed, has authority to cast into hell. Yea, I say to you, fear Him.

title: Luke 12:6
text: Are not five sparrows sold for two assaria? And not one of them is forgotten before God.

title: Luke 12:7
text: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Therefore do not fear, you are of more value than many sparrows.

title: Luke 12:8
text: Also I say to you, Whoever shall confess Me before men, the Son of man also shall confess him before the angels of God.

title: Luke 12:9
text: But he who denies Me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.

title: Luke 12:10
text: And whoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him. But to him who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit, [it] shall not be forgiven.

title: Luke 12:11
text: And when they bring you into the synagogues, and [to] rulers and authorities, take no thought as to how or what thing you shall answer, or what you shall say.

title: Luke 12:12
text: For the Holy Spirit shall teach you in the same hour what you ought to say.

title: Luke 12:13
text: And one of the company said to Him, Master, speak to my brother to divide the inheritance with me.

title: Luke 12:14
text: And He said to him, Man, who made Me a judge or a divider over you?

title: Luke 12:15
text: And He said to them, Watch and keep yourselves from covetousness. For a man's life is not in the abundance of the things which he possesses.

title: Luke 12:16
text: And He spoke a parable to them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully.

title: Luke 12:17
text: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room in which to store my fruits?

title: Luke 12:18
text: And he said, I will do this. I will pull down my barns and build bigger ones, and I will store all my fruits and my goods there.

title: Luke 12:19
text: And I will say to my soul, Soul, you have many goods laid [up] for many years. Take your ease, eat drink [and] be merry.

title: Luke 12:20
text: But God said to him, Fool! This night your soul shall be required of you, then whose shall be those things which you have prepared?

title: Luke 12:21
text: So [is] he who lays up treasure for himself and is not rich toward God.

title: Luke 12:22
text: And He said to His disciples, Therefore I say to you, Be not anxious as to your life, what you shall eat; nor for the body, what you shall put on.

title: Luke 12:23
text: Life is more than food, and the body [is more] than clothing.

title: Luke 12:24
text: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap, having neither storehouse nor barn, and God feeds them. How much more are you better than the birds?

title: Luke 12:25
text: And which of you [by] being anxious can add one cubit to his stature?

title: Luke 12:26
text: If then you are not able to do even the least, why are you anxious about the rest?

title: Luke 12:27
text: Consider the lilies, how they grow; they do not toil, they do not spin. And yet I say to you that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

title: Luke 12:28
text: If then God so clothes the grass (which today [is] in the field, and tomorrow is cast into the oven) how much more [will He clothe] you, O little-faiths?

title: Luke 12:29
text: And do not seek what you shall eat, nor what you shall drink, and stop being in anxiety.

title: Luke 12:30
text: For all these things the nations of the world seek after, and your Father knows that you have need of these things.

title: Luke 12:31
text: But rather seek the kingdom of God, and all these things shall be added to you.

title: Luke 12:32
text: Do not fear, little flock, for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

title: Luke 12:33
text: Sell what you have and give alms. Make for yourselves purses which do not become old, an unfailing treasure in Heaven, where no thief comes nor moth corrupts.

title: Luke 12:34
text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

title: Luke 12:35
text: Let your loins be girded about, and [your] lights burning.

title: Luke 12:36
text: And you yourselves be like men who wait for their lord, whenever he shall return from the wedding, so that when he comes and knocks, they may open to him immediately.

title: Luke 12:37
text: Blessed [are] those servants whom the lord will find watching when [he] comes. Truly I say to you that he shall gird himself and make them recline; and coming up he will serve them.

title: Luke 12:38
text: And if he comes in the second watch, or comes in the third watch, and find [it] so, blessed are those servants.

title: Luke 12:39
text: And know this, that if the master of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched and would not have allowed his house to be dug through.

title: Luke 12:40
text: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of man comes at an hour when you think not.

title: Luke 12:41
text: And Peter said to Him, Lord, do You speak this parable to us or also to all?

title: Luke 12:42
text: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward whom [his] lord shall set over his houseservants, to give [them their] portion of food in season?

title: Luke 12:43
text: Blessed [is] that servant [when] his lord comes [and] finds him so doing.

title: Luke 12:44
text: Truly I say to you that he will set him over all his possessions.

title: Luke 12:45
text: But if that servant says in his heart, My lord delays his coming, and shall begin to beat the male servants and women servants, and to eat and drink and to be drunk,

title: Luke 12:46
text: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he does not expect, and at an hour when he does not know. And he will cut him apart, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

title: Luke 12:47
text: And that servant who knew his lord's will and did not prepare, nor did according to His will, shall be beaten with many [stripes].

title: Luke 12:48
text: But he not knowing, and doing [things] worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few [stripes]. For to whomever much is given, of him much shall be required. And to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

title: Luke 12:49
text: I have come to send fire on the earth. And what will I do if it is already kindled?

title: Luke 12:50
text: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how I am pressed down until it is accomplished!

title: Luke 12:51
text: Do you suppose that I have come to give peace on earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

title: Luke 12:52
text: For from now on, there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

title: Luke 12:53
text: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

title: Luke 12:54
text: And He also said to the crowd, When you see a cloud rise out of the west, immediately you say, There is a shower coming. And so it is.

title: Luke 12:55
text: And when [you see] the south wind blow, you say, There will be heat; and it occurs.

title: Luke 12:56
text: Hypocrites! You know to discern the face of the heaven and the earth, but how [is it] that you do not discern this time?

title: Luke 12:57
text: And why, even of yourselves, do you not judge what is right?

title: Luke 12:58
text: For as you go with your adversary to the judge, give pains in the way to be set free from him, lest he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer cast you into the prison.

title: Luke 12:59
text: I tell you, you shall not depart from there until you have paid the very last lepton.

title: Luke 13:1
text: And some were present at the same time reporting to Him of the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

title: Luke 13:2
text: And answering, Jesus said to them, Do you suppose that these Galileans were sinners above all the Galileans because they suffered such things?

title: Luke 13:3
text: I tell you, No. But unless you repent, you will all likewise perish.

title: Luke 13:4
text: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them, do you think that they were sinners above all men who lived in Jerusalem?

title: Luke 13:5
text: I tell you, No. But unless you repent, you will all likewise perish.

title: Luke 13:6
text: He also spoke this parable: A certain [man] had a fig-tree planted in his vineyard. And he came and sought fruit on it, and found none.

title: Luke 13:7
text: And he said to the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig-tree, and find none. Cut it down, why does it encumber the ground?

title: Luke 13:8
text: And answering, he said to him, Lord, let it alone this year also, until I dig around it and throw manure.

title: Luke 13:9
text: And if it bears fruit, [well]; and if not, then after that you shall cut it down.

title: Luke 13:10
text: And He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

title: Luke 13:11
text: And behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bowed together and was not able to be completely erect.

title: Luke 13:12
text: And when Jesus saw her, He called and said to her, Woman, you are delivered from your infirmity.

title: Luke 13:13
text: And He laid [His] hands on her. And instantly she was made erect, and she glorified God.

title: Luke 13:14
text: And answering, the synagogue ruler, being angry because Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, said to the crowd, There are six days in which it is right to work. Therefore in them come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

title: Luke 13:15
text: And the Lord answered him and said, Hypocrite! Does not each one of you on the sabbath loosen his ox or ass from the stall and lead [it] away, to give [it] drink?

title: Luke 13:16
text: And ought not this [woman], being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan has bound, lo these eighteen years, be loosened from this bond on the Sabbath day?

title: Luke 13:17
text: And when He had said these things, all His adversaries were ashamed. And all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by Him.

title: Luke 13:18
text: And He said, What is the kingdom of God like? And to what shall I compare it?

title: Luke 13:19
text: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and threw into his garden. And it grew and became a great tree, and the birds of the air lodged in its branches.

title: Luke 13:20
text: And again He said, To what shall I compare the kingdom of God?

title: Luke 13:21
text: It is like leaven which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until the whole was leavened.

title: Luke 13:22
text: And He went through the cities and villages, teaching and progressing toward Jerusalem.

title: Luke 13:23
text: And one said to Him, Lord, [are] the ones being saved few? And He said to them,

title: Luke 13:24
text: Strive to enter in at the narrow gate. For I say to you, many will seek to enter in and shall not be able.

title: Luke 13:25
text: And once the Master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us, and He shall answer and say to you, I do not know you; from where are you;

title: Luke 13:26
text: then you shall begin to say, We ate and drank in Your presence, and You have taught in our streets.

title: Luke 13:27
text: But He shall say, I tell you, I do not know you; from where you are. Depart from Me, all workers of unrighteousness!

title: Luke 13:28
text: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you will see Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and yourselves being thrust out.

title: Luke 13:29
text: And they will come from the east and the west, and from the north and the south, and will recline in the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 13:30
text: And behold, there are last ones which will be first, and there are first ones which will be last.

title: Luke 13:31
text: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying to Him, Go out and depart from here, for Herod will kill you.

title: Luke 13:32
text: And He said to them, You go and tell that fox, Behold, today and tomorrow, I cast out demons and I complete cures, and the third [day] I will be finished.

title: Luke 13:33
text: Yet I must walk today and tomorrow and the [day] following. For it cannot be that a prophet perish outside of Jerusalem.

title: Luke 13:34
text: Jerusalem! Jerusalem! the [one] killing the prophets, and stoning those having been sent to her; how often I desired to gather your children in the way a hen [gathers] her brood under the wings, and you did not desire [it].

title: Luke 13:35
text: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. And truly I say to you, You will not see Me until it come when you say, Blessed [is] He who comes in [the] name of [the] Lord.

title: Luke 14:1
text: And as He went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, it happened that they watched Him.

title: Luke 14:2
text: And behold, a certain man was dropsical before Him.

title: Luke 14:3
text: And answering, Jesus spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath [day]?

title: Luke 14:4
text: And they were silent. And taking [him], He healed him and let him go.

title: Luke 14:5
text: And He answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fall into a pit and will not immediately pull him out on the sabbath day?

title: Luke 14:6
text: And they could not answer Him again as to these things.

title: Luke 14:7
text: And He put forth a parable to those who were invited, when He noted how they chose out the chief places, saying to them,

title: Luke 14:8
text: When you are invited by anyone to a wedding, do not recline in the chief seat, lest a more honorable [man] than you may be invited by him.

title: Luke 14:9
text: And he who invited you and him shall come and say to you, Give place to this man; and then you begin with shame to take the last place.

title: Luke 14:10
text: But when you are invited, go and recline in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may say to you, Friend, go up higher. Then glory shall be to you before those reclining with you.

title: Luke 14:11
text: For whoever exalts himself shall be abased, and he who humbles himself shall be exalted.

title: Luke 14:12
text: And He also said to him who invited Him, When you make a dinner or a supper, do not call your friends or your brothers, or your kinsmen, or [your] rich neighbors; lest they also invite you again, and a recompense be made to you.

title: Luke 14:13
text: But when you make a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind,

title: Luke 14:14
text: and you shall be blessed, for they cannot repay you; for you shall be repaid at the resurrection of the just.

title: Luke 14:15
text: And one of those who reclined with [Him] heard these things, and [he] said to Him, Blessed [are] those eating bread in the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 14:16
text: And He said to him, A certain man made a great supper and invited many.

title: Luke 14:17
text: And he sent his servant at supper time to say to those who were invited, Come, for all things are now ready.

title: Luke 14:18
text: And all with one [consent] began to make excuse. The first said to him, I have bought a piece of ground, I must go and see it. I beg you, have me excused.

title: Luke 14:19
text: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to test them. I beg you, have me excused.

title: Luke 14:20
text: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

title: Luke 14:21
text: And coming up that servant reported these things to his lord. And the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city and bring in here the poor and the maimed, and the lame and the blind.

title: Luke 14:22
text: And the servant said, Lord, [it] is done as you have commanded, and still there is room.

title: Luke 14:23
text: And the lord said to the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges and compel [them] to come in, so that my house may be filled.

title: Luke 14:24
text: For I say to you that none of these men who were invited shall taste of my supper.

title: Luke 14:25
text: And great crowds went with Him. And He turned and said to them,

title: Luke 14:26
text: If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters, yes, and his [own] life also, he cannot be My disciple.

title: Luke 14:27
text: And whoever does not bear his cross and come after Me, he cannot be My disciple.

title: Luke 14:28
text: For which of you, intending to build a tower, does not sit down first [and] count the cost, whether he may have [enough] to finish it;

title: Luke 14:29
text: lest perhaps, after he has laid the foundation and is not able to finish, all those seeing begin to mock him,

title: Luke 14:30
text: saying, This man began to build and was not able to finish.

title: Luke 14:31
text: Or what king, going to make war against another king, does not first sit down [and] consult whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

title: Luke 14:32
text: Or else, while the other is still a great way off, he sends a delegation and asks [conditions] of peace.

title: Luke 14:33
text: So then, everyone of you who does not forsake all his possessions, he cannot be My disciple.

title: Luke 14:34
text: Salt [is] good, but if the salt has become tasteless, with what shall it be seasoned?

title: Luke 14:35
text: It is not fit for the land, nor for manure, [but men] throw it out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

title: Luke 15:1
text: And all the tax-collectors and sinners drew near to Him in order to hear Him.

title: Luke 15:2
text: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receives sinners and eats with them.

title: Luke 15:3
text: And He spoke this parable to them, saying,

title: Luke 15:4
text: What man of you, having a hundred sheep, if he loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after that which is lost until he finds it?

title: Luke 15:5
text: And when he has found [it], he lays [it] on his shoulders, rejoicing.

title: Luke 15:6
text: And when he comes home, he calls together [his] friends and neighbors, saying to them, Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost.

title: Luke 15:7
text: I say to you that likewise joy shall be in Heaven over one sinner who repents, more than over ninety-nine just persons who need no repentance.

title: Luke 15:8
text: Or what woman having ten drachmas, if she loses one drachma, does she not light a lamp and sweep the house, and seek carefully until she finds [it]?

title: Luke 15:9
text: And when she has found [it], she calls [her] friends and her neighbors together, saying, Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost.

title: Luke 15:10
text: Likewise I say to you, there is joy before the angels of God over one sinner who repents.

title: Luke 15:11
text: And He said, A certain man had two sons.

title: Luke 15:12
text: And the younger of them said to [his] father, Father, give me the portion of goods that is coming [to me]. And he divided [his] living to them.

title: Luke 15:13
text: And not many days afterward, the younger son gathered all together and went away into a far country. And there he wasted his property, living dissolutely.

title: Luke 15:14
text: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land. And he began to be in want.

title: Luke 15:15
text: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country. And he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

title: Luke 15:16
text: And he was longing to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, and no one gave to him.

title: Luke 15:17
text: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father abound in loaves, and I perish with hunger!

title: Luke 15:18
text: I will arise and go to my father, and will say to him, Father, I have sinned against Heaven and before you

title: Luke 15:19
text: and am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.

title: Luke 15:20
text: And he arose and came to his father. But when he was still a great way off, his father saw him and had compassion, and ran and fell on his neck and kissed him.

title: Luke 15:21
text: And the son said to him, Father, I have sinned against Heaven and before you, and am no more worthy to be called your son.

title: Luke 15:22
text: But the father said to his servants, Bring the best robe and put [it] on him. And put a ring on his hand and shoes on [his] feet.

title: Luke 15:23
text: And bring the fattened calf here and kill [it]. And let us eat and be merry,

title: Luke 15:24
text: for this my son was dead and is alive again, he was lost and is found. And they began to be merry.

title: Luke 15:25
text: And his elder son was in the field. And as he came and drew near the house, he heard music and dancing.

title: Luke 15:26
text: And he called one of the servants and asked what these things meant.

title: Luke 15:27
text: And he said to him, Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf because he has received him safe and sound.

title: Luke 15:28
text: And he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and entreated him.

title: Luke 15:29
text: And answering he said to [his] father, Lo, these many years I have served you, neither did I transgress your commandment at any time. And yet you never gave [me] a kid so that I might make merry with my friends.

title: Luke 15:30
text: But when this son of yours came, who has devoured your living with harlots, you have killed for him the fattened calf.

title: Luke 15:31
text: And he said to him, Son, you are always with me, and all that I have is yours.

title: Luke 15:32
text: It was right that we should make merry and be glad, for this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

title: Luke 16:1
text: And He also said to His disciples, There was a certain rich man who had a steward. And he was accused to him, that he had wasted his goods.

title: Luke 16:2
text: And he called him and said to him, What [is] this I hear about you? Give an account of your stewardship, for you may no longer be steward.

title: Luke 16:3
text: And the steward said within himself, What shall I do? For my lord is taking the stewardship away from me. I cannot dig; I am ashamed to beg.

title: Luke 16:4
text: I know what I will do, so that when I am put out of the stewardship they may receive me into their houses.

title: Luke 16:5
text: So he called every one of his lord's debtors and said; to the first, How much do you owe my lord?

title: Luke 16:6
text: And he said, A hundred baths of oil. And he said to him, Take your bill and sit down quickly and write fifty.

title: Luke 16:7
text: And he said to another, And how much do you owe? And he said, A hundred cors of wheat. And he said to him, Take your bill and write eighty.

title: Luke 16:8
text: And the unjust steward's lord commended him because he had done wisely. For the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

title: Luke 16:9
text: And I say to you, Make friends by the mammon of unrighteousness for yourselves, so that when you fail, they may receive you into everlasting dwellings.

title: Luke 16:10
text: He who is faithful in [the] least is also faithful in much. And he who is unjust in the least is also unjust in much.

title: Luke 16:11
text: Therefore if you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will entrust the true [riches] to you?

title: Luke 16:12
text: And if you have not been faithful in that which is another's, who shall give you that which is your own?

title: Luke 16:13
text: No servant can serve two masters. For either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will hold to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.

title: Luke 16:14
text: And being money-lovers, all the Pharisees also heard all these things. And they derided Him.

title: Luke 16:15
text: And He said to them, You are those who justify yourselves before men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

title: Luke 16:16
text: The law and the prophets [were] until John. Since that time the kingdom of God is proclaimed, and everyone is pressing into it.

title: Luke 16:17
text: And it is easier [for] the heaven and earth to pass than for one tittle of the law to fail.

title: Luke 16:18
text: Everyone putting away his wife and marrying another commits adultery; and everyone marrying her who is put away from [her] husband commits adultery.

title: Luke 16:19
text: There was a certain rich man who [was] customarily clothed in purple and fine linen and making merry in luxury every day.

title: Luke 16:20
text: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, who was laid at his gate, full of sores

title: Luke 16:21
text: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table. But even the dogs came and licked his sores.

title: Luke 16:22
text: And it happened that the beggar died and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom. The rich one also died and was buried.

title: Luke 16:23
text: And in hell he lifted up his eyes, being in torments, and saw Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

title: Luke 16:24
text: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me and send Lazarus so that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, for I am tormented in this flame.

title: Luke 16:25
text: But Abraham said, Son, remember that you in your lifetime received your good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things. But now he is comforted and you are tormented.

title: Luke 16:26
text: And besides all this, there is a great chasm fixed between you and us; so that they desiring to pass from here to you cannot, nor can they pass over to us from there.

title: Luke 16:27
text: And he said, I beg you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father's house,

title: Luke 16:28
text: for I have five brothers, so that he may testify to them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

title: Luke 16:29
text: Abraham said to him, They have Moses and the prophets, let them hear them.

title: Luke 16:30
text: And he said, No, father Abraham, but if one should go to them from [the] dead, they would repent.

title: Luke 16:31
text: And he said to him, If they do not hear Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded, even though one rose from [the] dead.

title: Luke 17:1
text: And He said to the disciples, It is impossible but that offenses will come. But woe [to him] through whom they come!

title: Luke 17:2
text: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged around his neck and he were cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

title: Luke 17:3
text: Take heed to yourselves. If your brother trespasses against you, rebuke him. And if he repents, forgive him.

title: Luke 17:4
text: And if he trespasses against you seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turns again to you, saying, I repent, you shall forgive him.

title: Luke 17:5
text: And the apostles said to the Lord, Give us more faith.

title: Luke 17:6
text: And the Lord said, If you had faith as a grain of mustard seed, you might say to this sycamine tree, Be rooted up and be planted in the sea! And it would obey you.

title: Luke 17:7
text: But which of you who has a servant plowing or feeding will say [to him] immediately after he has come from the field, Come, recline?

title: Luke 17:8
text: Will [he] not say to him, Prepare something [so that] I may eat, and gird yourself and serve me until I eat and drink. And afterward you shall eat and drink.

title: Luke 17:9
text: [Does] he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I think not.

title: Luke 17:10
text: So likewise you, when you shall have done all the things commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants, for we have done what we ought to do.

title: Luke 17:11
text: And as He went to Jerusalem, it happened that he went through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

title: Luke 17:12
text: And as He entered into a certain village, ten leprous men met Him, who stood afar off.

title: Luke 17:13
text: And they lifted voice and said, Jesus, Master, pity us!

title: Luke 17:14
text: And seeing [them], He said to them, Go show yourselves to the priests. And it happened, as they went, that they were cleansed.

title: Luke 17:15
text: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back and glorified God with a loud voice.

title: Luke 17:16
text: And he fell down on [his] face at His feet, thanking Him. And he was a Samaritan.

title: Luke 17:17
text: And answering, Jesus said, Were there not ten cleansed? But where [are] the nine?

title: Luke 17:18
text: Were none found who returned to give glory to God except this foreigner?

title: Luke 17:19
text: And He said to him, Rise and go, your faith has cured you.

title: Luke 17:20
text: And being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, He answered and said, The kingdom of God does not come with observation.

title: Luke 17:21
text: Nor shall they say, Lo here! or, behold, there! For behold, the kingdom of God is in your midst.

title: Luke 17:22
text: And He said to the disciples, The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and you shall not see [it].

title: Luke 17:23
text: And they shall say to you, Lo, here! or, behold, there! Do not go away, nor follow.

title: Luke 17:24
text: For as the lightning which lights up, flashing from the [one part] under heaven, [and] shines to the [other part] under heaven, so also shall the Son of man be in His day.

title: Luke 17:25
text: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected of this generation.

title: Luke 17:26
text: And as it was in the days of Noah, so it also shall be in the days of the Son of man.

title: Luke 17:27
text: They ate, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until [the] day that Noah entered into the ark; and the flood came and destroyed [them] all.

title: Luke 17:28
text: So also as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

title: Luke 17:29
text: but the day Lot went out of Sodom, it rained fire and brimstone from the heaven and destroyed [them] all.

title: Luke 17:30
text: Even so it shall be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

title: Luke 17:31
text: In that day he who shall be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not come down to take them away. And likewise, he who is in the field, let him not return to the things behind.

title: Luke 17:32
text: Remember Lot's wife.

title: Luke 17:33
text: Whoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it, and whoever shall lose [his life] shall preserve it.

title: Luke 17:34
text: I tell you, in that night there shall be two in one bed, the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

title: Luke 17:35
text: Two shall be grinding together, one will be taken, and the other left.

title: Luke 17:36
text: Two shall be in the field, one will be taken, and the other left.

title: Luke 17:37
text: And they answered and said to Him, Where, Lord? And He said to them, Wherever the body [is], there the eagles will be gathered together.

title: Luke 18:1
text: And He also spoke a parable to them to [teach] it is always right to pray, and not to faint,

title: Luke 18:2
text: saying, A certain judge was in a certain city, not fearing God, nor respecting man.

title: Luke 18:3
text: And a widow was in that city. And she came to Him, saying, Avenge me of my adversary.

title: Luke 18:4
text: And he would not do so for a time. But afterward he said within himself, Though I do not fear God nor regard man,

title: Luke 18:5
text: yet because this widow troubles me, I will avenge her, that she not wear me down in [the] end.

title: Luke 18:6
text: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge says.

title: Luke 18:7
text: And shall not God avenge His own elect who cry day and night to Him, though He has been long-suffering over them?

title: Luke 18:8
text: I say to you that He will avenge them speedily. Yet when the Son of man comes, shall He find faith on the earth?

title: Luke 18:9
text: And He spoke this parable to certain ones who trusted in themselves, that they were righteous, and despised others:

title: Luke 18:10
text: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a tax-collector.

title: Luke 18:11
text: The Pharisee stood and prayed within himself in this way: God, I thank You that I am not as other men [are], extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even like this tax-collector.

title: Luke 18:12
text: I fast twice [in] the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

title: Luke 18:13
text: And standing afar off, the tax-collector would not even lift up [his] eyes to Heaven, but struck on his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner!

title: Luke 18:14
text: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified [rather] than the other. For everyone who exalts himself shall be abased, and he who humbles himself shall be exalted.

title: Luke 18:15
text: And they also brought infants to Him, that He might touch them. But when the disciples saw, they, rebuked them.

title: Luke 18:16
text: But Jesus called them and said, Allow the little children to come to Me, and forbid them not. For of such is the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 18:17
text: Truly I say to you, Whoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no way enter into it.

title: Luke 18:18
text: And a certain ruler asked Him, saying, Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

title: Luke 18:19
text: And Jesus said to him, Why do you call Me good? None [is] good except One, God.

title: Luke 18:20
text: You know the commandments: Do not commit adultery, do not kill, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and your mother.

title: Luke 18:21
text: And he said, I have kept all these from my youth up.

title: Luke 18:22
text: And when Jesus heard these things, He said to him, Yet you lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute to [the] poor, and you shall have treasure in Heaven. And come, follow Me.

title: Luke 18:23
text: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful, for he was very rich.

title: Luke 18:24
text: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, He said, How hardly those having riches shall enter into the kingdom of God!

title: Luke 18:25
text: For it is easier [for] a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich one to enter into the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 18:26
text: And the ones who heard said, And who can be saved?

title: Luke 18:27
text: And He said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

title: Luke 18:28
text: And Peter said, Lo, we have left all and have followed You.

title: Luke 18:29
text: And He said to them, Truly I say to you, There is no one who has left house, or parents, or brothers, or wife, or children for the sake of the kingdom of God,

title: Luke 18:30
text: who shall not receive many times more in this present time, and in the world to come everlasting life.

title: Luke 18:31
text: And He took the Twelve and said to them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man will be accomplished.

title: Luke 18:32
text: For He will be delivered to the nations and will be mocked and insulted and spat on.

title: Luke 18:33
text: And they will scourge [Him] and put Him to death, and the third day He will rise again.

title: Luke 18:34
text: And they did not understand any of these things. And this saying was hidden from them, nor did they know the things which were spoken.

title: Luke 18:35
text: And as He came near Jericho, it happened that a certain blind man sat by the roadside begging.

title: Luke 18:36
text: And hearing the crowd pass by, he asked what it meant.

title: Luke 18:37
text: And they told him that Jesus of Nazareth passed by.

title: Luke 18:38
text: And he cried, saying, Jesus, Son of David! Have mercy on me.

title: Luke 18:39
text: And they who were in front rebuked him that he should be quiet. But he cried so much the more, Son of David! Have mercy on me.

title: Luke 18:40
text: And Jesus stood and commanded him to be brought to Him. And when he had come near, He asked him,

title: Luke 18:41
text: saying, What do you desire that I should do to you? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

title: Luke 18:42
text: And Jesus said to him, Receive your sight! Your faith has saved you.

title: Luke 18:43
text: And immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. And when they saw, all the people gave praise to God.

title: Luke 19:1
text: And going in, He passed through Jericho.

title: Luke 19:2
text: And behold, [there was] a man named Zaccheus, who was a chief tax-collector. And he was rich.

title: Luke 19:3
text: And he sought to see Jesus, to see who He was. And he could not because of the press, because he was little in stature.

title: Luke 19:4
text: And he ran in front and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see Him. For He was to pass through that [way].

title: Luke 19:5
text: And when Jesus came to the place, He looked up and saw him. And He said to him, Zaccheus! Hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.

title: Luke 19:6
text: And hurrying he came down, and received Him joyfully.

title: Luke 19:7
text: And seeing, they all murmured, saying, He has gone in to stay with a sinful man.

title: Luke 19:8
text: And Zaccheus stood and said to the Lord, Behold, Lord, I give half of my goods to the poor. And [in] anything I accused anyone falsely, I restore [it] fourfold.

title: Luke 19:9
text: And Jesus said to him, This day salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

title: Luke 19:10
text: For the Son of man has come to seek and to save that which was lost.

title: Luke 19:11
text: And as they heard these things, He added and spoke a parable, because He was near Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God was about to appear immediately.

title: Luke 19:12
text: Therefore He said, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive a kingdom for himself, and to return.

title: Luke 19:13
text: And He called his ten servants and delivered ten minas, and said to them, Trade until I come back.

title: Luke 19:14
text: But his citizens hated him. And they sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this one to reign over us.

title: Luke 19:15
text: And when he had received his kingdom and had returned, then it happened that he commanded these servants to be called to him; the ones to whom he had given the silver; so that he might know what each had gained by trading.

title: Luke 19:16
text: And came the first, saying, Lord, your mina has gained ten minas.

title: Luke 19:17
text: And he said to him, Well [done], good servant, because you have been faithful in a very little, have authority over ten cities.

title: Luke 19:18
text: And the second came, saying, Lord, your mina has made five minas.

title: Luke 19:19
text: And he said the same to him, You be over five cities.

title: Luke 19:20
text: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, [here is] your mina, which I have kept in a handkerchief.

title: Luke 19:21
text: For I feared you, because you are a harsh man. You take up what you did not lay down, and you reap what you did not sow.

title: Luke 19:22
text: And he said to him, I will judge you out of your own mouth, wicked servant! You knew that I was a harsh man, taking up what I had not laid down and reaping what I did not sow.

title: Luke 19:23
text: And why did you not give my silver on the [bank] table, and coming I might have exacted it with interest?

title: Luke 19:24
text: And he said to those who stood by, Take the mina from him and give [it] to him who has ten minas.

title: Luke 19:25
text: And they said to him, Lord, he has ten minas.

title: Luke 19:26
text: For I say to you that to everyone who has, more will be given. And from him who has not, even that which he has will be taken from him.

title: Luke 19:27
text: But those who are my enemies, who did not desire that I should reign over them, bring them here and slay [them] before me.

title: Luke 19:28
text: And saying these things, He went in front, going up to Jerusalem.

title: Luke 19:29
text: And it happened as He drew near Bethphage and Bethany, toward the mount called Mount of Olives, He sent two of the disciples,

title: Luke 19:30
text: saying, Go into the village across [from you], and having entered, you will find a colt tied up, on which no one of men has yet sat. Untie it and bring [it].

title: Luke 19:31
text: And if anyone asks you, Why are you untying [it]? You will say this to him, Because the Lord has need of it.

title: Luke 19:32
text: And going, those who were sent found as He had said to them.

title: Luke 19:33
text: And [as] they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, Why are you untying the colt?

title: Luke 19:34
text: And they said, The Lord has need of him.

title: Luke 19:35
text: And they brought him to Jesus. And they threw their garments on the colt. And they set Jesus on [it].

title: Luke 19:36
text: And as He went, they spread their clothes in the way.

title: Luke 19:37
text: And when He had come near, even now at the descent of the Mount of Olives, all the multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all [the] mighty works which they had seen,

title: Luke 19:38
text: saying, Blessed [is] the King coming in the name of the Lord! Peace in Heaven and glory in [the] highest!

title: Luke 19:39
text: And some of the Pharisees from the crowd said to Him, Teacher, rebuke your disciples.

title: Luke 19:40
text: And He answered and said to them, I tell you that if these should be silent, the stones would cry out.

title: Luke 19:41
text: And as He drew near, He beheld the city and wept over it,

title: Luke 19:42
text: saying, If you had known, even you, even at least in this day of yours, the things for your peace! But now they are hidden from your eyes.

title: Luke 19:43
text: For the days will come on you that your enemies will raise up a rampart to you, and will surround you, and will keep you in on every side.

title: Luke 19:44
text: And they will tear you down, and your children within you, and will not leave a stone on a stone because you did not know the time of your visitation.

title: Luke 19:45
text: And entering into the temple, He began to cast out those selling and buying in it,

title: Luke 19:46
text: saying to them, It is written, "My house is a house of prayer," but you have made it a den of thieves.

title: Luke 19:47
text: And He taught in the temple daily. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy Him.

title: Luke 19:48
text: And [they] could not find what they might do, for all the people were hanging on Him, listening.

title: Luke 20:1
text: And on one of those days, as He taught the people in the temple and proclaimed the gospel, it happened that the chief priests and the scribes along with the elders came on [Him].

title: Luke 20:2
text: And they spoke to Him, saying, Tell us, by what authority do you do these things? Or who is he who gave you this authority?

title: Luke 20:3
text: And He answered and said to them, I will also ask you one thing, and you answer me:

title: Luke 20:4
text: The baptism of John, was it from Heaven or from men?

title: Luke 20:5
text: And they reasoned within themselves, saying, If we shall say, From Heaven, he will say, Why then did you not believe him?

title: Luke 20:6
text: But if we say, From men, then all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.

title: Luke 20:7
text: And they answered that they could not tell from where [it was].

title: Luke 20:8
text: And Jesus said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

title: Luke 20:9
text: And He began to speak to the people this parable: A certain man planted a vineyard and let it out to vinedressers. And [he] went into a far country for a long time.

title: Luke 20:10
text: And in season he sent a servant to the vinedressers, so that they should give him the fruit of the vineyard. But the vinedressers beat him and sent [him] away empty.

title: Luke 20:11
text: And again he sent another servant. And they also beat him and treated [him] shamefully, and sent [him] away empty.

title: Luke 20:12
text: And again he sent a third. And they also wounded him and cast [him] out.

title: Luke 20:13
text: And the lord of the vineyard said, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that they will respect [him] when they see him.

title: Luke 20:14
text: But when the vinedressers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir! Come, let us kill him so that the inheritance may be ours.

title: Luke 20:15
text: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed [him]. What then shall the lord of the vineyard do to them?

title: Luke 20:16
text: He shall come and destroy these vinedressers and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard this, they said, Let it not be!

title: Luke 20:17
text: And He looked at them and said, What then is this which is written, "[The] Stone which the builders rejected, the same has become [the] Head of [the] corner?

title: Luke 20:18
text: Whoever shall fall on that Stone shall be broken, but on whomever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder."

title: Luke 20:19
text: And the chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on Him the same hour. And [they] feared the people, for they perceived that He had spoken this parable against them.

title: Luke 20:20
text: And they watched and sent forth spies, pretending themselves to be righteous men, so that they might seize upon a word of His, that they might deliver Him in this way to the power and authority of the governor.

title: Luke 20:21
text: And they asked Him, saying, Teacher, we know that you say and teach rightly, and do not accept the person of anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

title: Luke 20:22
text: Is it lawful for us to give tribute to Caesar or not?

title: Luke 20:23
text: But He perceived their craftiness and said to them, Why do you tempt Me?

title: Luke 20:24
text: Show Me a coin. Whose image and inscription does it have? They answered and said, Caesar's.

title: Luke 20:25
text: And He said to them, Therefore render to Caesar the things which are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's.

title: Luke 20:26
text: And they could not take hold of His words before the people. And they marveled at His answer and were silent.

title: Luke 20:27
text: And certain of the Sadducees came, those speaking against a resurrection, [that it was] not to be. And they asked Him,

title: Luke 20:28
text: saying, Teacher, Moses wrote to us, If anyone's brother dies, having a wife, and if he dies without children, his brother should take his wife and raise up seed to his brother.

title: Luke 20:29
text: Therefore there were seven brothers. And the first took a wife and died without children.

title: Luke 20:30
text: And the second took her as a wife, and he died childless.

title: Luke 20:31
text: And the third took her. And likewise the seven left no children and died.

title: Luke 20:32
text: Last of all the woman also died.

title: Luke 20:33
text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be? For the seven had her [as] a wife.

title: Luke 20:34
text: And answering, Jesus said to them, The sons of this world marry and are given in marriage,

title: Luke 20:35
text: but they who shall be counted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from [the] dead, neither marry nor are given in marriage.

title: Luke 20:36
text: Nor can they die [any] more, for they are equal to the angels, and are the sons of God, being the sons of the resurrection.

title: Luke 20:37
text: But that the dead are raised, even Moses pointed out at the Bush, when he called [the] Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

title: Luke 20:38
text: For He is not God of [the] dead, but of the living. For all live to Him.

title: Luke 20:39
text: And answering, certain of the scribes said, Teacher, you have spoken well.

title: Luke 20:40
text: And after that they did not dare ask Him anything.

title: Luke 20:41
text: And He said to them, How do they say that Christ is the Son of David?

title: Luke 20:42
text: Even David himself says in [the] Book of Psalms, "The LORD said to my Lord, Sit at My right hand

title: Luke 20:43
text: until I place Your enemies as Your footstool."

title: Luke 20:44
text: David then calls Him Lord; how then is He his son?

title: Luke 20:45
text: And as all the people were listening, He said to the disciples,

title: Luke 20:46
text: Beware of the scribes who desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the first seats in the synagogues, and the chief places at the feasts;

title: Luke 20:47
text: who devour widows' houses, and make long prayers for a show; the same shall receive a more severe condemnation.

title: Luke 21:1
text: And looking up, He saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

title: Luke 21:2
text: And He also saw a certain poor widow casting two lepta in there.

title: Luke 21:3
text: And He said, Truly I say to you that this poor widow has cast [in] more than all of them.

title: Luke 21:4
text: For all these have cast in to the offerings of God from their abundance, but out of her poverty she has cast [in] all the living she had.

title: Luke 21:5
text: And as some spoke of the temple, how it was adorned with beautiful stones and gifts, He said,

title: Luke 21:6
text: [As to] these things which you see, days will come in which there shall not be left a stone on a stone, which shall not be thrown down.

title: Luke 21:7
text: And they asked Him, saying, Teacher, but when shall these things be? And what [shall be] the sign when these things are about to take place?

title: Luke 21:8
text: And He said, Take heed that you are not deceived, for many shall come in My name, saying, I AM! Also, The time has come! Do not go after them.

title: Luke 21:9
text: But when you hear of wars and disturbances, do not be terrified, for all these things must first occur, but the end [is] not at once.

title: Luke 21:10
text: And He said to them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

title: Luke 21:11
text: And great earthquakes shall be in different places, and famines and plagues. And there shall be terrors and great signs from Heaven.

title: Luke 21:12
text: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you and persecute [you], delivering [you] up to the synagogues and prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for My name's sake.

title: Luke 21:13
text: And it shall return to you for a testimony.

title: Luke 21:14
text: Therefore settle [it] in your hearts not to meditate beforehand what you shall answer.

title: Luke 21:15
text: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

title: Luke 21:16
text: And you shall be betrayed also by parents and brothers and kinsmen and friends. And they will cause [some] of you to be put to death.

title: Luke 21:17
text: And you shall be hated by all for My name's sake.

title: Luke 21:18
text: But there shall not a hair of your head perish.

title: Luke 21:19
text: By your patience you will gain your souls.

title: Luke 21:20
text: And when you see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that its destruction has come.

title: Luke 21:21
text: And let those in Judea flee to the mountains. And those in its midst, let them go out. And those in the open spaces, let them not go into her.

title: Luke 21:22
text: For these are the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

title: Luke 21:23
text: But woe to those who are with child, and to those suckling in those days! For there shall be great distress in the land and wrath on this people.

title: Luke 21:24
text: And they shall fall by [the] sword's edge. And shall be led away captive into all nations. And Jerusalem shall be trodden down by the nations until [the] times of [the] nations is fulfilled.

title: Luke 21:25
text: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars. And on the earth [will be] anxiety of nations with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

title: Luke 21:26
text: men fainting from fear, and expecting those things which have come on the earth. For the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.

title: Luke 21:27
text: And then they shall see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

title: Luke 21:28
text: And when these things begin to happen, then look up and lift up your heads, for your redemption draws near.

title: Luke 21:29
text: And He spoke a parable to them: Behold the fig-tree and all the trees.

title: Luke 21:30
text: Now when they sprout leaves, seeing [it] you will know that summer is now near.

title: Luke 21:31
text: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.

title: Luke 21:32
text: Truly I say to you, This generation shall not pass away until all [these] things are fulfilled.

title: Luke 21:33
text: The heaven and the earth shall pass away, but My words shall not pass away.

title: Luke 21:34
text: And take heed to yourselves, lest your hearts are weighed down with headaches and drinking and anxieties of this life; and that day should suddenly come on you;

title: Luke 21:35
text: for it shall come as a snare on all those sitting on [the] face of the whole earth.

title: Luke 21:36
text: Watch therefore, praying in every season that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things which shall occur, and to stand before the Son of man.

title: Luke 21:37
text: And [in] the days He was teaching in the temple. And [in] the nights He went out, and lodged in the mount called [the Mount] of Olives.

title: Luke 21:38
text: And all the people came early in the morning to Him in the temple, in order to hear Him.

title: Luke 22:1
text: And the Feast of Unleavened Bread, which is called the Passover, drew near.

title: Luke 22:2
text: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill Him, for they feared the people.

title: Luke 22:3
text: And Satan entered into Judas, surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the Twelve.

title: Luke 22:4
text: And going, he talked with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray Him to them.

title: Luke 22:5
text: And they were glad and they agreed to give him silver.

title: Luke 22:6
text: And he fully consented, and he sought opportunity to betray Him to them, away from [the] crowd.

title: Luke 22:7
text: And the day of the Unleavened Bread came, when the passover must be killed.

title: Luke 22:8
text: And He sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare the passover for us, so that we may eat.

title: Luke 22:9
text: And they said to Him. Where do You desire that we prepare?

title: Luke 22:10
text: And He said to them, Behold, when you have entered into the city, you will meet a man bearing a pitcher of water. Follow him into the house where he enters.

title: Luke 22:11
text: And you shall say to the master of the house, The Teacher says to you, Where is the guest room where I shall eat the passover with My disciples?

title: Luke 22:12
text: And he shall show you a large, furnished upper room. Prepare there.

title: Luke 22:13
text: And they went and found it as He had said to them. And they prepared the passover.

title: Luke 22:14
text: And when the hour came, He and the twelve apostles with Him reclined.

title: Luke 22:15
text: And He said to them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer.

title: Luke 22:16
text: For I say to you, I will not any more eat of it until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 22:17
text: And He took the cup and gave thanks and said, Take this and divide [it] among yourselves.

title: Luke 22:18
text: For I say to you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God shall come.

title: Luke 22:19
text: And He took bread and gave thanks, and He broke [it] and gave [it] to them, saying, This is My body which is given for you, this do in remembrance of Me.

title: Luke 22:20
text: In the same way also the cup, after having dined, saying, This cup [is] the new covenant in My blood, which is being poured out for you.

title: Luke 22:21
text: But, behold, the hand of My betrayer [is] with Me on the table.

title: Luke 22:22
text: And truly the Son of man goes, as it has been determined, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed!

title: Luke 22:23
text: And they began to inquire among themselves which of them it was that should do this thing.

title: Luke 22:24
text: And there was also a dispute among them as to which of them seems to be greater.

title: Luke 22:25
text: And He said to them, The kings of the nations exercise lordship over them. And they who exercise authority on them are called benefactors.

title: Luke 22:26
text: But you [shall] not [be] so: but the greater among you, let him be as the lesser, and he who governs, as [one] who serves.

title: Luke 22:27
text: For which [is] the greater; he who reclines, or he who serves? [Is] it not he who reclines? But I am among you as He who serves.

title: Luke 22:28
text: You are those who have continued with Me in My trials.

title: Luke 22:29
text: And I appoint a kingdom to you, as My Father has appointed to Me,

title: Luke 22:30
text: that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

title: Luke 22:31
text: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has desired you, that he may sift [you] as wheat.

title: Luke 22:32
text: But I have prayed for you, that your faith fail not. And when you are converted, strengthen your brothers.

title: Luke 22:33
text: And he said to Him, Lord, I am ready to go with You, both into prison and into death.

title: Luke 22:34
text: And He said, I say to you, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day before you shall deny knowing Me three times.

title: Luke 22:35
text: And He said to them, When I sent you without purse and wallet and sandals, did you lack anything? And they said, Nothing.

title: Luke 22:36
text: And He said to them, But now, he who has a purse, let him take [it], and likewise [his] wallet. And he who has no sword, let him sell his garment and buy one.

title: Luke 22:37
text: For I say to you that this which is written must yet be accomplished in Me, "And he was reckoned among the transgressors"; for the things concerning Me have an end.

title: Luke 22:38
text: And they said, Lord, behold, here [are] two swords. And He said to them, It is enough.

title: Luke 22:39
text: And going out, according to [His] custom, He went to the Mount of Olives. And His disciples also followed Him.

title: Luke 22:40
text: And when He was at the place, He said to them, Pray that you do not enter into temptation.

title: Luke 22:41
text: And He was withdrawn from them about a stone's throw. And He kneeled down and prayed,

title: Luke 22:42
text: saying, Father, if You are willing, remove this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.

title: Luke 22:43
text: And an angel appeared to Him from Heaven, strengthening Him.

title: Luke 22:44
text: And being in an agony He prayed more earnestly. And His sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

title: Luke 22:45
text: And when He rose up from prayer and had come to His disciples, He found them sleeping because of sorrow.

title: Luke 22:46
text: And [He] said to them, Why do you sleep? Rise and pray lest you enter into temptation.

title: Luke 22:47
text: And [as] He [was] yet speaking, behold a crowd! And he who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, went before them. And he drew near Jesus to kiss Him.

title: Luke 22:48
text: But Jesus said to him, Judas, do you betray the Son of man with a kiss?

title: Luke 22:49
text: And those around Him seeing what was about to occur, [they] said to him, Lord, shall we strike with the sword?

title: Luke 22:50
text: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.

title: Luke 22:51
text: And Jesus answered and said, Let [it] go until now. And touching his ear, He healed him.

title: Luke 22:52
text: And Jesus said to the chief priests and commanders of the temple, and the elders, who had come to Him, Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and staves?

title: Luke 22:53
text: When I was with you in the temple daily, you did not stretch out your hand on Me. But this is your hour, and the authority of the darkness.

title: Luke 22:54
text: And laying hold on Him, they led [Him] away and brought Him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

title: Luke 22:55
text: And lighting a fire in [the] middle of the court, and they sitting down, Peter sat in their midst.

title: Luke 22:56
text: But a certain slave-girl saw him as he sat by the fire and earnestly looked on him and said, This [man] was with him also.

title: Luke 22:57
text: And he denied Him, saying, Woman, I do not know Him.

title: Luke 22:58
text: And after a little while another saw him and said, You also are of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not!

title: Luke 22:59
text: And about an hour afterward, another confidently affirmed, saying, Truly this one was also with him, for he is a Galilean.

title: Luke 22:60
text: And Peter said, Man, I do not know what you say. And immediately, while he still spoke, the cock crowed.

title: Luke 22:61
text: And the Lord turned and looked on Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He had said to him, Before the cock crows, you shall deny Me three times.

title: Luke 22:62
text: And Peter went out and wept bitterly.

title: Luke 22:63
text: And the men who held Jesus mocked Him, beating [Him].

title: Luke 22:64
text: And blindfolding Him, [they] struck Him on His face. And they asked Him, saying, Prophesy! Who is it who struck you?

title: Luke 22:65
text: And they spoke many other things blasphemously against Him.

title: Luke 22:66
text: And when day came, the body of elders of the people, and the chief priests and the scribes, came together. And they led Him to the sanhedrin, saying,

title: Luke 22:67
text: Are you the Christ? Tell us. And He said to them, If I tell you, you will not believe.

title: Luke 22:68
text: Also if I ask [you], you will not answer Me nor let Me go.

title: Luke 22:69
text: From now on the Son of man shall sit at the right [hand] of the power of God.

title: Luke 22:70
text: And they all said, Are you then the Son of God? And He said to them, You say [it], because I AM!

title: Luke 22:71
text: And they said, What need do we have for any witness? For we ourselves have heard it from his own mouth.

title: Luke 23:1
text: And rising up, all the multitude of them led Him before Pilate.

title: Luke 23:2
text: And they began to accuse Him, saying, We have found this one perverting the nation and forbidding them to give tribute to Caesar, saying himself to be a king, Christ.

title: Luke 23:3
text: And Pilate asked Him, saying, Are you the king of the Jews? And He answered him and said, You say [it].

title: Luke 23:4
text: And Pilate said to the chief priests and [to] the people, I find no fault in this man.

title: Luke 23:5
text: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee to this place.

title: Luke 23:6
text: And hearing Galilee, Pilate asked if the man is a Galilean.

title: Luke 23:7
text: And knowing that He belonged to Herod's jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who himself was also at Jerusalem at that time.

title: Luke 23:8
text: And seeing Jesus, Herod greatly rejoiced, for he had desired to see Him [for] a long [time], because he had heard many things about Him. And he hoped to see some miracle done by Him.

title: Luke 23:9
text: And he questioned Him in many words, but He answered him nothing.

title: Luke 23:10
text: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused Him.

title: Luke 23:11
text: And humiliating Him with his guardsmen, and mocking [Him] by putting luxurious clothing around Him, Herod sent Him again to Pilate.

title: Luke 23:12
text: And that same day Pilate and Herod became friends with one another, for before they were at enmity [between] themselves.

title: Luke 23:13
text: And when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

title: Luke 23:14
text: Pilate said to them, You have brought this Man to me as perverting the people. And behold, having examined [Him] before you, I have found no fault in this Man [regarding those things] of which you accuse Him;

title: Luke 23:15
text: no, nor even Herod, for I sent you to him, and lo, nothing worthy of death has been done by Him.

title: Luke 23:16
text: Therefore I will chastise Him and release [Him].

title: Luke 23:17
text: (For it was necessary for him to release one to them at the feast.)

title: Luke 23:18
text: And they all cried out at once, saying, Away with this One! And release to us Barabbas

title: Luke 23:19
text: (who was thrown into prison because of a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder).

title: Luke 23:20
text: And Pilate, willing to release Jesus, spoke again to them.

title: Luke 23:21
text: But they cried, saying, Crucify! Crucify Him!

title: Luke 23:22
text: And he said to them the third [time], Why? What evil has He done? I have found no cause of death in Him, therefore I will chastise Him and let [Him] go.

title: Luke 23:23
text: But they pressed [on him], with loud voices, requesting that He might be crucified. And their voices and those of the chief priests prevailed.

title: Luke 23:24
text: And Pilate gave judgment that their request should be granted.

title: Luke 23:25
text: And he released to them [the one] who had been thrown into prison for sedition and murder, for whom they had asked. But he delivered up Jesus to their will.

title: Luke 23:26
text: And as they led Him away, they laid hold on one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country. And they laid the cross on him, that he might carry [it] after Jesus.

title: Luke 23:27
text: And a great multitude of people were following Him, and of women who also were bewailing and lamenting Him.

title: Luke 23:28
text: But turning to them, Jesus said, Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

title: Luke 23:29
text: For behold, the days are coming in which they shall say, Blessed [are] the barren, and the wombs that never bore, and the breasts which did not suckle.

title: Luke 23:30
text: And they shall begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us! And to the hills, Cover us!

title: Luke 23:31
text: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?

title: Luke 23:32
text: And two others, two criminals, were led with Him to be put to death.

title: Luke 23:33
text: And when they came to the place which is called Calvary, they crucified Him and the criminals there, one on [the] right, and one on [the] left.

title: Luke 23:34
text: And Jesus said, Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they do. And parting His clothing, they cast lots.

title: Luke 23:35
text: And the people stood watching. And also the rulers with them, scoffing, saying, He saved others, let Him save Himself, if He is the Christ, the chosen of God.

title: Luke 23:36
text: And coming near, the soldiers also mocked Him, and offering Him sour wine,

title: Luke 23:37
text: and saying, If You are the king of the Jews, save Yourself.

title: Luke 23:38
text: And an inscription also was written over Him in letters of Greek and Latin and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

title: Luke 23:39
text: And one of the hanged criminals blasphemed Him, saying, If you are Christ, save Yourself and us.

title: Luke 23:40
text: But answering, the other rebuked him, saying, Do you not fear God, since [you] are in the same condemnation.

title: Luke 23:41
text: And we indeed justly so, for we receive the due reward of our deeds, but this Man has done nothing amiss.

title: Luke 23:42
text: And he said to Jesus, Lord, remember me when You come into Your kingdom.

title: Luke 23:43
text: And Jesus said to him, Truly I say to you, Today you shall be with Me in Paradise.

title: Luke 23:44
text: And it was about [the] sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until [the] ninth hour.

title: Luke 23:45
text: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in the middle.

title: Luke 23:46
text: And crying with a loud voice, Jesus said, Father, into Your hands I commit My spirit. And when He had said this, He breathed out the spirit.

title: Luke 23:47
text: And when the centurion saw what had been done, he glorified God, saying, Truly this Man was righteous.

title: Luke 23:48
text: And all the crowd arriving together at this sight, beholding the things happening, struck their breasts and returned.

title: Luke 23:49
text: And all those known to Him stood at a distance; and [the] women, those accompanying Him from Galilee, [were] seeing these things.

title: Luke 23:50
text: And behold, a man named Joseph, a councillor, a good man and a just one,

title: Luke 23:51
text: this one was not assenting to their counsel and deed. [He was] from Arimathea, a city of the Jews; and he also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

title: Luke 23:52
text: This [man] went to Pilate and begged the body of Jesus.

title: Luke 23:53
text: And he took it down and wrapped it in linen. And he laid it in a tomb that had been cut in the stone, in which no man had before been laid.

title: Luke 23:54
text: And that day was the Preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

title: Luke 23:55
text: And also women [were] following, who were accompanying Him out of Galilee, who watched the tomb, and how His body was placed.

title: Luke 23:56
text: And they returned and [they] prepared spices and ointment. And they rested [on] the sabbath day according to the commandment.

title: Luke 24:1
text: And [on] the first of the sabbaths, while still very early, they came to the tomb bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.

title: Luke 24:2
text: But they found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

title: Luke 24:3
text: And going in, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

title: Luke 24:4
text: And as they were much perplexed about it, it happened that, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments.

title: Luke 24:5
text: And as they were afraid, and bowed [their] faces down to the earth, they said to them, Why do you seek the living among the dead?

title: Luke 24:6
text: He is not here, but has risen. Remember how He spoke to you when He was still in Galilee,

title: Luke 24:7
text: saying, The Son of man must be delivered into [the] hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?

title: Luke 24:8
text: And they remembered His words

title: Luke 24:9
text: and returned from the tomb and told all these things to the Eleven and to the rest.

title: Luke 24:10
text: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary [the mother] of James, and the rest with them, who told these things to the apostles.

title: Luke 24:11
text: And their words seemed to them like foolishness, and they did not believe them.

title: Luke 24:12
text: And Peter arose and ran to the tomb, and stooping down he saw the linens lying alone. And he went away wondering to himself at what had happened.

title: Luke 24:13
text: And behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, it being [about] sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

title: Luke 24:14
text: And they talked to each other of all these things which had happened.

title: Luke 24:15
text: And while they talked and reasoned, it happened that Jesus Himself drew near and went with them.

title: Luke 24:16
text: But their eyes were held [so that] they could not know Him.

title: Luke 24:17
text: And He said to them, What words [are] these that you have with one another [as] you walk, and are so sad.

title: Luke 24:18
text: And one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answered and said to Him, [Are] you only a stranger in Jerusalem and have not known the things which have occurred there in these days?

title: Luke 24:19
text: And He said to them, What things? And they said to Him, The things concerning Jesus of Nazareth, who was a man, prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people,

title: Luke 24:20
text: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered Him to [the] judgement of death, and have crucified Him.

title: Luke 24:21
text: But we had trusted that He was the One who was about to redeem Israel. And besides all this, today is the third day since these things were done.

title: Luke 24:22
text: Yes, and also some of our women astounded us, having been early at the tomb;

title: Luke 24:23
text: and when they did not find His body, [they] came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that He was alive.

title: Luke 24:24
text: And some of those with us went to the tomb and found [it] even as the women had said. But they did not see Him.

title: Luke 24:25
text: And He said to them, O fools and slow of heart to believe all things that the prophets spoke!

title: Luke 24:26
text: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and to enter into His glory?

title: Luke 24:27
text: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, He expounded to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning Himself.

title: Luke 24:28
text: And they drew near the village where they were going. And He appeared to be going further.

title: Luke 24:29
text: But they constrained Him, saying, Stay with us, for it is toward evening and the day is far spent. And He went in to stay with them.

title: Luke 24:30
text: And it happened [as] He reclined with them, taking the loaf, He blessed [it], and breaking it, He gave to them.

title: Luke 24:31
text: And their eyes were opened, and they knew Him. And He became invisible to them.

title: Luke 24:32
text: And they said to one another, Did not our heart burn within us while He talked with us by the way and while He opened the Scriptures to us?
